    /* ==========================================
                BACKGROUND CANVAS
    ========================================== */

    const canvas =
        document.createElement("canvas");

    canvas.id =
        "gchat-canvas";


    chatArea.insertBefore(
        canvas,
        chatArea.firstChild
    );


    const ctx =
        canvas.getContext("2d");


    function resizeCanvas(){

        if(!chatArea.isConnected)
            return;

        canvas.width =
            Math.max(
                1,
                chatArea.clientWidth
            );

        canvas.height =
            Math.max(
                1,
                chatArea.clientHeight
            );

    }


    resizeCanvas();


    /* ==========================================
                EVENT CONTROL
    ========================================== */

    const eventController =
        new AbortController();

    const signal =
        eventController.signal;


    /* ==========================================
                MOUSE
    ========================================== */

    const mouse = {

        x:-1000,
        y:-1000

    };


    function updateMouse(e){

        const rect =
            canvas.getBoundingClientRect();

        mouse.x =
            e.clientX - rect.left;

        mouse.y =
            e.clientY - rect.top;

    }


    document.addEventListener(
        "pointermove",
        updateMouse,
        {signal}
    );


    document.addEventListener(
        "pointerleave",
        ()=>{

            mouse.x = -1000;
            mouse.y = -1000;

        },
        {signal}
    );


    /* ==========================================
                    ACTIVITY
    ========================================== */

    let activity = 0;
    let activityTarget = 0;
    let typingTimeout = null;


    function triggerTyping(){

        activityTarget = 1;

        clearTimeout(
            typingTimeout
        );

        typingTimeout =
            setTimeout(()=>{

                activityTarget = 0;

            },1800);

    }


    document.addEventListener(
        "input",
        e=>{

            const t = e.target;

            if(
                t instanceof HTMLTextAreaElement ||
                t.isContentEditable
            ){

                triggerTyping();

            }

        },
        {signal}
    );


    /* ==========================================
                    STARS
    ========================================== */

    const stars = [];


    for(let i=0;i<90;i++){

        const depth =
            Math.random();


        stars.push({

            x:
                Math.random() *
                canvas.width,

            y:
                Math.random() *
                canvas.height,

            vx:0,
            vy:0,

            depth:depth,

            radius:
                .35 +
                depth * 1.6,

            twinkle:
                Math.random() *
                Math.PI * 2,

            twinkleSpeed:
                .008 +
                depth * .025,

            color:
                Math.random() < .18
                ? "120,210,255"
                : "255,255,255"

        });

    }


    /* ==========================================
                AMBIENT PARTICLES
    ========================================== */

    const ambientParticles = [];


    for(let i=0;i<35;i++){

        ambientParticles.push({

            x:
                Math.random() *
                canvas.width,

            y:
                Math.random() *
                canvas.height,

            vx:
                (Math.random()-.5) *
                .12,

            vy:
                (Math.random()-.5) *
                .12,

            radius:
                .5 +
                Math.random() * 1.2,

            alpha:
                .08 +
                Math.random() * .15

        });

    }


    /* ==========================================
                FLOW FIELD
    ========================================== */

    const FLOW_COLS = 48;
    const FLOW_ROWS = 30;

    const flowField = [];


    for(let y=0;y<FLOW_ROWS;y++){

        for(let x=0;x<FLOW_COLS;x++){

            flowField.push({

                x:x,
                y:y,

                angle:
                    Math.random() *
                    Math.PI * 2,

                offset:
                    Math.random() * 1000

            });

        }

    }


    function sampleFlow(x,y){

        const gx =
            Math.max(
                0,
                Math.min(
                    FLOW_COLS-1,
                    Math.floor(
                        x /
                        canvas.width *
                        FLOW_COLS
                    )
                )
            );


        const gy =
            Math.max(
                0,
                Math.min(
                    FLOW_ROWS-1,
                    Math.floor(
                        y /
                        canvas.height *
                        FLOW_ROWS
                    )
                )
            );


        return flowField[
            gy * FLOW_COLS + gx
        ];

    }


    /* ==========================================
                NEBULA
    ========================================== */

    /* ---- 3D depth nebula: calm, layered, soft parallax ---- */

    const nebulaParticles = [];

    const NEBULA_RGB = {
        blue:    [ 43,108,255],
        violet:  [132, 88,255],
        cyan:    [ 95,216,255],
        magenta: [212,109,255],
        dust:    [  0,  0,  0]
    };

    /* Pre-render soft sprites once (with built-in dithering against banding) */
    function makeNebulaSprite(rgb, cored){

        const size = 256;
        const c = document.createElement("canvas");
        c.width = c.height = size;
        const g = c.getContext("2d");
        const img = g.createImageData(size, size);
        const half = size / 2;

        for(let y=0;y<size;y++){
            for(let x=0;x<size;x++){

                const dx = (x + .5 - half) / half;
                const dy = (y + .5 - half) / half;
                const r2 = dx*dx + dy*dy;

                let a = 0;

                if(r2 < 1){

                    const k = 1 - r2;

                    a = cored
                        ? .62 * Math.pow(k,2) + .38 * Math.pow(k,6)
                        : Math.pow(k,2.2);

                }

                a = a * 255 + (Math.random() - .5) * 3.5;
                a = Math.max(0, Math.min(255, a));

                const i = (y * size + x) * 4;
                img.data[i]   = rgb[0];
                img.data[i+1] = rgb[1];
                img.data[i+2] = rgb[2];
                img.data[i+3] = a;

            }
        }

        g.putImageData(img, 0, 0);
        return c;

    }

    const nebulaSprites = {};

    let nebula2DReady = false;

    /* only built if the 3D renderer is unavailable */
    function ensureNebula2D(){

        if(nebula2DReady)
            return;

        nebula2DReady = true;

        for(const name in NEBULA_RGB){

            nebulaSprites[name] = {
                soft:  makeNebulaSprite(NEBULA_RGB[name], false),
                cored: makeNebulaSprite(NEBULA_RGB[name], true)
            };

        }

        populateNebulaParticles();

    }

    function pickNebulaColor(z){

        const r = Math.random();

        /* far = cool and deep, near = brighter with a little warmth */
        if(z < .4){

            return r < .5 ? "blue"
                 : r < .85 ? "violet"
                 : "cyan";

        }

        if(z < .75){

            return r < .3 ? "blue"
                 : r < .62 ? "violet"
                 : r < .92 ? "cyan"
                 : "magenta";

        }

        return r < .15 ? "blue"
             : r < .4  ? "violet"
             : r < .78 ? "cyan"
             : "magenta";

    }

    function populateNebulaParticles(){

        for(let i=0;i<150;i++){

            const z = Math.random();

            const focus = z > .35 && z < .8;

            nebulaParticles.push({

                x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
                y: Math.random() * canvas.height,

                vx:0,
                vy:0,

                z:z,
                dust:false,

                radius:
                    (230 - z * 110) +
                    Math.random() * 80,

                color: pickNebulaColor(z),

                /* depth of field: mid layer is in focus, the rest is soft */
                sprite: focus ? "cored" : "soft",

                alpha:
                    .035 +
                    Math.random() * .035,

                phase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2

            });

        }

        /* Dust lanes: carve the glow away to add depth and contrast */
        for(let i=0;i<9;i++){

            const z = .3 + Math.random() * .4;

            nebulaParticles.push({

                x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
                y: Math.random() * canvas.height,

                vx:0,
                vy:0,

                z:z,
                dust:true,

                radius: 200 + Math.random() * 130,

                color:"dust",
                sprite:"soft",

                alpha: .22 + Math.random() * .14,

                phase: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2

            });

        }

        /* far -> near draw order so near wisps overlap far clouds */
        nebulaParticles.sort((a,b) => a.z - b.z);

    }



    /* ==========================================
        3D SPACE (WebGL2): volumetric nebula, 3D stars,
        meteors and cursor physics. Replaces the 2D
        nebula/stars/meteors when WebGL2 is available.
    ========================================== */

    /* ==========================================
        3D SPACE RENDERER (WebGL2)  v2
        - Huge world: the camera flies between random
          3D waypoints, turning to face each one.
        - Volumetric nebula (raymarched gas + dust).
          Rendered in interleaved bands across several
          frames and reprojected to the live camera, so
          GPU cost per frame is flat and the frame rate
          stays high.
        - Star field lives in world space on the GPU
          (periodic around the camera: effectively
          infinite). Dust dims and reddens stars.
        - Meteors bend around the cursor.
        - 4K-class output buffer, no GPU read-backs,
          no per-frame allocations.
    ========================================== */

    function createSpaceRenderer(cv, opts){

        opts = opts || {};

        /* quality state shared across reloads (the host passes the same object) */
        const Q = opts.quality || {};

        const FOCAL = 1.15;          /* camera focal length               */
        const Z0 = 2.6;              /* nebula volume near plane          */
        const Z1 = 30.0;             /* nebula volume far plane           */
        const ZC = 8.0;              /* depth the cursor acts around      */
        const MAXD = 0.22;           /* (shader constant, unused now)     */
        const BULK = [0.050, -0.012, -0.018]; /* slow drift of the medium */
        const NS = 128;              /* noise volume resolution           */
        const DARKEN = 0.62;         /* how much the page bg is dimmed    */

        /* ---- tunables ---- */
        const TARGET_PIXELS = 3840 * 2160;  /* output buffer: 4K class    */
        const CAM_SPEED = 1.1;       /* units / second                    */
        const CAM_TURN = 0.11;       /* max turn rate, rad / second       */
        const OVERSCAN = 1.05;       /* nebula texture is a bit wider     */
        const REPROJ_Z = 9.0;        /* depth used to compensate parallax */

        /* star cubes (periodic around the camera): count and half size */
        const STAR_LAYERS = [
            { n:40000, H:95 },
            { n:36000, H:55 },
            { n:40000, H:30 }
        ];
        const N_GIANT = 80,   H_GIANT = 40;
        const N_MOTE = 130,   H_MOTE = 3.2;
        const DYN_MAX = 256;
        const N_MET = 5;
        const TRAIL = 22;

        if(Q.pixels === undefined) Q.pixels = opts.pixels || TARGET_PIXELS;
        if(Q.bands === undefined)  Q.bands = 8;
        if(Q.steps === undefined)  Q.steps = 56;
        if(Q.nebH === undefined)   Q.nebH = 0;
        if(Q.stage === undefined)  Q.stage = 0;

        let gl = null;

        try{

            gl = cv.getContext("webgl2", {
                alpha:true,
                premultipliedAlpha:true,
                antialias:false,
                depth:false,
                stencil:false,
                powerPreference:"high-performance",
                failIfMajorPerformanceCaveat: opts.allowSoftware ? false : true
            });

        }catch(e){ gl = null; }

        if(!gl)
            return null;

        /* =====================================================================
            SHADERS
        ===================================================================== */

        const VS_FULL = `#version 300 es
    void main(){
        vec2 p = vec2(float((gl_VertexID << 1) & 2), float(gl_VertexID & 2));
        gl_Position = vec4(p * 2.0 - 1.0, 0.0, 1.0);
    }`;
        const FS_BAKE = `#version 300 es
    precision highp float;
    precision highp int;
    uniform float uLayer;
    uniform float uSize;
    out vec4 o;

    uvec3 pcg3d(uvec3 v){
        v = v * 1664525u + 1013904223u;
        v.x += v.y * v.z; v.y += v.z * v.x; v.z += v.x * v.y;
        v ^= v >> 16u;
        v.x += v.y * v.z; v.y += v.z * v.x; v.z += v.x * v.y;
        return v;
    }
    vec3 gradAt(vec3 cell, float period, uint seed){
        vec3 c = mod(cell, period);
        uvec3 h = pcg3d(uvec3(ivec3(c)) + uvec3(seed * 747796405u, seed * 2891336453u + 17u, seed * 277803737u + 91u));
        vec3 g = vec3(h) * (1.0 / 4294967295.0) * 2.0 - 1.0;
        return g / (length(g) + 1e-4);
    }
    float gn(vec3 p, float period, uint seed){
        vec3 i = floor(p);
        vec3 f = fract(p);
        vec3 u = f * f * f * (f * (f * 6.0 - 15.0) + 10.0);
        float n000 = dot(gradAt(i + vec3(0,0,0), period, seed), f - vec3(0,0,0));
        float n100 = dot(gradAt(i + vec3(1,0,0), period, seed), f - vec3(1,0,0));
        float n010 = dot(gradAt(i + vec3(0,1,0), period, seed), f - vec3(0,1,0));
        float n110 = dot(gradAt(i + vec3(1,1,0), period, seed), f - vec3(1,1,0));
        float n001 = dot(gradAt(i + vec3(0,0,1), period, seed), f - vec3(0,0,1));
        float n101 = dot(gradAt(i + vec3(1,0,1), period, seed), f - vec3(1,0,1));
        float n011 = dot(gradAt(i + vec3(0,1,1), period, seed), f - vec3(0,1,1));
        float n111 = dot(gradAt(i + vec3(1,1,1), period, seed), f - vec3(1,1,1));
        return mix(mix(mix(n000, n100, u.x), mix(n010, n110, u.x), u.y),
                   mix(mix(n001, n101, u.x), mix(n011, n111, u.x), u.y), u.z);
    }
    float fbmP(vec3 p, float base, int oct, uint seed){
        float s = 0.0, a = 0.5, n = 0.0, per = base;
        for(int i = 0; i < 5; i++){
            if(i >= oct) break;
            s += a * gn(p * per, per, seed + uint(i) * 7u);
            n += a; per *= 2.0; a *= 0.5;
        }
        return s / n;
    }
    float ridgeP(vec3 p, float base, int oct, uint seed){
        float s = 0.0, a = 0.5, n = 0.0, per = base;
        for(int i = 0; i < 5; i++){
            if(i >= oct) break;
            float v = 1.0 - abs(gn(p * per, per, seed + uint(i) * 7u));
            s += a * v * v;
            n += a; per *= 2.0; a *= 0.5;
        }
        return s / n;
    }
    void main(){
        vec3 w = vec3(gl_FragCoord.xy / uSize, uLayer);
        float r = fbmP(w, 3.0, 4, 11u);
        float g = fbmP(w, 3.0, 4, 23u);
        float b = fbmP(w, 5.0, 3, 37u);
        float a = ridgeP(w, 3.0, 4, 41u);
        o = vec4(0.5 + 0.5 * clamp(r * 1.9, -1.0, 1.0),
                 0.5 + 0.5 * clamp(g * 1.9, -1.0, 1.0),
                 0.5 + 0.5 * clamp(b * 1.9, -1.0, 1.0),
                 clamp(a * 1.35 - 0.12, 0.0, 1.0));
    }`;
        const COMMON = `
    uniform sampler3D uNoise;
    uniform float uTime;
    uniform vec3 uCP;
    uniform mat3 uCR;
    uniform float uBias;
    const float FOCAL = ${FOCAL.toFixed(3)};
    const float Z0 = ${Z0.toFixed(2)};
    const float Z1 = ${Z1.toFixed(2)};
    const float SG = 0.55;
    const float SD = 2.4;
    const float S1 = 1.45;
    const float S2 = 2.6;
    const float SDU = 0.50;
    const vec3 BULK = vec3(${BULK[0]}, ${BULK[1]}, ${BULK[2]});

    vec3 nq(vec3 p){
        return (p - BULK * uTime) * 0.15 + vec3(0.31, 0.17, 0.53);
    }
    struct Med { float gas; float dust; float tint; float fil; };

    Med mediumFull(vec3 p, float detail){
        vec3 q = nq(p);
        vec3 wv = textureLod(uNoise, q * 0.42 + vec3(0.0, 0.0, uTime * 0.0016), 0.0).rgb - 0.5;
        vec3 pw = q + wv * 0.95;
        float b1 = textureLod(uNoise, pw * S1, 0.0).r;
        float b2 = textureLod(uNoise, pw * S2 + vec3(0.31, 0.12, 0.77), 0.0).g;
        float base = 0.62 * b1 + 0.38 * b2;
        float shape = smoothstep(0.495 - uBias, 0.70 - uBias, base);
        float fil = 0.0;
        float fine = 0.0;
        if(detail > 0.02 && shape > 0.001){
            fil = textureLod(uNoise, pw * 1.7 + vec3(0.12, 0.9, 0.4), 0.0).a;
            fine = textureLod(uNoise, pw * 2.7 + vec3(0.6, 0.2, 0.8), 0.0).b - 0.5;
        }
        float gas = shape * max(0.0, 0.16 + detail * (3.2 * fil * fil * fil + 1.2 * fine));
        float dust = smoothstep(0.57, 0.74, textureLod(uNoise, q * SDU + vec3(0.71, 0.33, 0.19) + wv * 0.5, 0.0).g);
        return Med(gas, dust, 0.0, fil * detail);
    }
    void mediumLite(vec3 p, out float gas, out float dust){
        vec3 q = nq(p);
        vec3 wv = textureLod(uNoise, q * 0.42 + vec3(0.0, 0.0, uTime * 0.0016), 0.0).rgb - 0.5;
        vec3 pw = q + wv * 0.95;
        float b1 = textureLod(uNoise, pw * S1, 0.0).r;
        float b2 = textureLod(uNoise, pw * S2 + vec3(0.31, 0.12, 0.77), 0.0).g;
        gas = smoothstep(0.495 - uBias, 0.70 - uBias, 0.62 * b1 + 0.38 * b2) * 0.67;
        dust = smoothstep(0.57, 0.74, textureLod(uNoise, q * SDU + vec3(0.71, 0.33, 0.19) + wv * 0.5, 0.0).g);
    }
    float gasLite(vec3 p){
        float g; float d;
        mediumLite(p, g, d);
        return g;
    }
    /* only the gas term (used for shadow taps): no unused dust fetch */
    float gasOnly(vec3 p){
        vec3 q = nq(p);
        vec3 wv = textureLod(uNoise, q * 0.42 + vec3(0.0, 0.0, uTime * 0.0016), 0.0).rgb - 0.5;
        vec3 pw = q + wv * 0.95;
        float b1 = textureLod(uNoise, pw * S1, 0.0).r;
        float b2 = textureLod(uNoise, pw * S2 + vec3(0.31, 0.12, 0.77), 0.0).g;
        return smoothstep(0.495 - uBias, 0.70 - uBias, 0.62 * b1 + 0.38 * b2) * 0.67;
    }
    /* colour tint: fetched only where gas is actually lit */
    float tintAt(vec3 p){
        return textureLod(uNoise, nq(p) * 0.20 + vec3(0.2, 0.8, 0.4), 0.0).b;
    }
    /* optical depth from the camera to world point P */
    float tauTo(vec3 P){
        float zEnd = min(P.z, Z1);
        if(zEnd <= Z0) return 0.0;
        const int N = 12;
        float lz = log(zEnd / Z0) / float(N);
        float rl = length(P / P.z);
        float tau = 0.0;
        for(int i = 0; i < N; i++){
            float z = Z0 * exp((float(i) + 0.5) * lz);
            float g; float d;
            mediumLite(uCP + uCR * (P * (z / P.z)), g, d);
            tau += (g * SG + d * SD) * z * lz * rl;
        }
        return tau;
    }
    vec3 starColor(float t){
        vec3 c = mix(vec3(1.0, 0.52, 0.30), vec3(1.0, 0.84, 0.64), smoothstep(0.0, 0.35, t));
        c = mix(c, vec3(0.96, 0.96, 1.0), smoothstep(0.30, 0.62, t));
        c = mix(c, vec3(0.58, 0.76, 1.0), smoothstep(0.60, 1.00, t));
        return c;
    }
    `;

        /* reprojection of a texture rendered at pose (Ci,Ri) to pose (Co,Ro) */
        const REPROJ = `
    vec2 reproj(vec2 uvOut, vec3 Co, mat3 Ro, vec3 Ci, mat3 Ri, float M, vec2 dims, float Zr){
        vec3 P = Co + Ro * (vec3(uvOut / FOCAL, 1.0) * Zr);
        vec3 q = transpose(Ri) * (P - Ci);
        vec2 uvi = q.xy / max(q.z, 0.05) * FOCAL;
        vec2 s = uvi / M;
        return vec2(s.x * dims.y / dims.x + 0.5, s.y + 0.5);
    }
    `;

        /* 5-tap Catmull-Rom: keeps detail sharp when the history is reprojected */
        const CATMULL = `
    vec4 sampleCR(sampler2D t, vec2 uv, vec2 dims){
        vec2 pos = uv * dims;
        vec2 c = floor(pos - 0.5) + 0.5;
        vec2 f = pos - c;
        vec2 w0 = f * (-0.5 + f * (1.0 - 0.5 * f));
        vec2 w1 = 1.0 + f * f * (-2.5 + 1.5 * f);
        vec2 w2 = f * (0.5 + f * (2.0 - 1.5 * f));
        vec2 w3 = f * f * (-0.5 + 0.5 * f);
        vec2 w12 = w1 + w2;
        vec2 off12 = w2 / w12;
        vec2 t0 = (c - 1.0) / dims;
        vec2 t3 = (c + 2.0) / dims;
        vec2 t12 = (c + off12) / dims;
        vec4 r = texture(t, vec2(t12.x, t0.y)) * (w12.x * w0.y)
               + texture(t, vec2(t0.x, t12.y)) * (w0.x * w12.y)
               + texture(t, vec2(t12.x, t12.y)) * (w12.x * w12.y)
               + texture(t, vec2(t3.x, t12.y)) * (w3.x * w12.y)
               + texture(t, vec2(t12.x, t3.y)) * (w12.x * w3.y);
        return max(r, 0.0);
    }
    `;

        const FS_NEB = `#version 300 es
    precision highp float;
    precision highp int;
    precision highp sampler3D;
    precision highp sampler2D;
    uniform vec2 uRes;
    uniform float uFrame;
    uniform float uAct;
    uniform int uSteps;
    uniform int uK;
    uniform int uBand;
    uniform float uM;
    uniform vec3 uHP;
    uniform mat3 uHR;
    uniform float uHistOn;
    uniform sampler2D uHist;
    uniform float uBlend;
    uniform vec4 uLP[10];
    uniform vec4 uLC[10];
    out vec4 fragColor;
    const float ZC = ${ZC.toFixed(1)};
    const float MAXD = ${MAXD.toFixed(3)};
    const float DARK = ${DARKEN.toFixed(3)};
    ${COMMON}
    ${REPROJ}
    ${CATMULL}
    float ign(vec2 p){
        return fract(52.9829189 * fract(dot(p, vec2(0.06711056, 0.00583715))));
    }
    float hash12(vec2 p){
        vec3 p3 = fract(vec3(p.xyx) * 0.1031);
        p3 += dot(p3, p3.yzx + 33.33);
        return fract((p3.x + p3.y) * p3.z);
    }
    vec3 tintColor(float t){
        vec3 blue = vec3(0.14, 0.30, 1.00);
        vec3 teal = vec3(0.08, 0.70, 0.95);
        vec3 vio  = vec3(0.42, 0.24, 0.98);
        vec3 rose = vec3(1.00, 0.34, 0.68);
        vec3 c = mix(teal, blue, smoothstep(0.30, 0.48, t));
        c = mix(c, vio, smoothstep(0.55, 0.72, t));
        c = mix(c, rose, smoothstep(0.84, 0.97, t) * 0.65);
        return c;
    }
    void main(){
        if(uK > 1){
            int blk = int(gl_FragCoord.y * 0.125);
            if(blk % uK != uBand) discard;
        }
        vec2 uvN = (gl_FragCoord.xy - 0.5 * uRes) / uRes.y * uM;
        vec2 uv = uvN / uM;
        vec3 rd = vec3(uvN / FOCAL, 1.0);
        float rl = length(rd);
        float jit = hash12(gl_FragCoord.xy + fract(uFrame * 0.61803) * vec2(113.0, 71.0));
        float lz = log(Z1 / Z0) / float(uSteps);
        const vec3 Lk = normalize(vec3(-0.45, 0.55, -0.70));
        vec3 C = vec3(0.0);
        float T = 1.0;

        for(int i = 0; i < 96; i++){
            if(i >= uSteps) break;
            float z = Z0 * exp((float(i) + jit) * lz);
            float ds = z * lz * rl;
            vec3 p = rd * z;
            vec3 pw = uCP + uCR * p;
            vec3 ps = pw;
            float detail = (1.0 - 0.8 * smoothstep(10.0, 30.0, z)) * smoothstep(Z0, Z0 + 2.5, z) * (1.0 - 0.85 * smoothstep(6.55, 18.6, z));

            Med m = mediumFull(ps, detail);
            float sg = m.gas * SG;
            float sd = m.dust * SD;
            float sigma = sg + sd;
            if(sigma < 0.003) continue;

            vec3 S = vec3(0.0);
            if(m.gas > 0.015){
                vec3 base = tintColor(tintAt(ps));
                float sh = exp(-(gasOnly(ps + Lk * 1.1) + gasOnly(ps + Lk * 2.6)) * 1.9);
                float key = 0.10 + 1.25 * sh;
                vec3 Ls = vec3(0.0);
                for(int j = 0; j < 10; j++){
                    vec3 d = pw - uLP[j].xyz;
                    float att = 1.0 / (1.0 + dot(d, d) * uLP[j].w);
                    Ls += uLC[j].rgb * att;
                }
                S = base * (0.24 * key + 0.02) * (1.0 + 3.2 * m.fil * m.fil) + (base * 0.75 + 0.25) * Ls * 0.34;
                float hz = smoothstep(8.0, 28.0, z);
                S = mix(S, S * vec3(0.55, 0.76, 1.10) * 0.78, hz);
                S *= (sg / sigma);
            }

            float a = (1.0 - exp(-sigma * ds)) * smoothstep(Z0, Z0 + 1.5, z);
            C += T * a * S * (1.0 + 0.25 * uAct);
            T *= 1.0 - a;
            if(T < 0.02) break;
        }

        vec3 col = 1.0 - exp(-C * 0.95);
        col = pow(col, vec3(1.12));
        col += vec3(0.002, 0.005, 0.012);
        float vig = 1.0 - 0.26 * smoothstep(0.35, 1.0, length(uv * vec2(0.8, 1.0)));
        col *= vig;
        float mx = max(col.r, max(col.g, col.b));
        float alpha = DARK + (1.0 - DARK) * mx;
        vec4 fresh = vec4(col, alpha);
        if(uHistOn > 0.5){
            vec2 tc = reproj(uvN, uCP, uCR, uHP, uHR, uM, uRes, ${REPROJ_Z.toFixed(1)});
            float inb = step(0.0, tc.x) * step(tc.x, 1.0) * step(0.0, tc.y) * step(tc.y, 1.0);
            vec4 prev = sampleCR(uHist, tc, uRes);
            fragColor = mix(fresh, prev, uBlend * inb);
        } else {
            fragColor = fresh;
        }
    }`;

        /* sharpening, done once per nebula update (not per 4K pixel per frame) */
        const FS_SHARP = `#version 300 es
    precision highp float;
    uniform sampler2D uTex;
    uniform vec2 uDim;
    out vec4 o;
    void main(){
        vec2 tc = gl_FragCoord.xy / uDim;
        vec2 tx = 1.0 / uDim;
        vec4 c = texture(uTex, tc);
        vec4 bl = 0.25 * (texture(uTex, tc + vec2(tx.x, 0.0)) + texture(uTex, tc - vec2(tx.x, 0.0)) + texture(uTex, tc + vec2(0.0, tx.y)) + texture(uTex, tc - vec2(0.0, tx.y)));
        c = max(c + (c - bl) * 0.45, 0.0);
        c.a = max(c.a, max(c.r, max(c.g, c.b)));
        o = c;
    }`;

        /* composite: coarse mesh warps the nebula to the live camera */
        const VS_COMP = `#version 300 es
    precision highp float;
    in vec2 aG;
    uniform vec2 uRes;
    uniform vec2 uNDim;
    uniform float uM;
    uniform vec3 uCP;
    uniform mat3 uCR;
    uniform vec3 uNP;
    uniform mat3 uNR;
    const float FOCAL = ${FOCAL.toFixed(3)};
    ${REPROJ}
    out vec2 vTc;
    void main(){
        vec2 uvOut = (aG - 0.5) * vec2(uRes.x / uRes.y, 1.0);
        vTc = reproj(uvOut, uCP, uCR, uNP, uNR, uM, uNDim, ${REPROJ_Z.toFixed(1)});
        gl_Position = vec4(aG * 2.0 - 1.0, 0.0, 1.0);
    }`;

        const FS_COMP = `#version 300 es
    precision highp float;
    uniform sampler2D uTex;
    uniform vec2 uNDim;
    uniform float uFrame;
    in vec2 vTc;
    out vec4 o;
    float ign(vec2 p){
        return fract(52.9829189 * fract(dot(p, vec2(0.06711056, 0.00583715))));
    }
    void main(){
        vec4 c = texture(uTex, vTc);
        float n = ign(gl_FragCoord.xy + fract(uFrame * 0.618) * vec2(37.0, 17.0)) - 0.5;
        c.rgb = max(c.rgb + n * (1.6 / 255.0), 0.0);
        c.a = max(c.a, max(c.r, max(c.g, c.b)));
        o = c;
    }`;

        /* stars: world-space (static buffer) or view-space (dynamic buffer) */
        const VS_STAR = `#version 300 es
    precision highp float;
    precision highp int;
    precision highp sampler3D;
    in vec3 aPos;
    in vec4 aInfo;
    uniform vec2 uRes;
    uniform float uPxScale;
    uniform float uGain;
    uniform float uMaxPt;
    uniform float uWorld;
    uniform float uH;
    uniform vec3 uCw;
    uniform vec2 uLim;
    uniform vec3 uMT[4];
    uniform float uMOn;
    uniform float uMS;
    uniform vec4 uSh[3];
    const float ZC = ${ZC.toFixed(1)};
    ${COMMON}
    out vec3 vCol;
    out float vKind;
    out float vBlur;
    void main(){
        vec3 v;
        if(uWorld > 0.5){
            vec3 rel = aPos - uCw;
            float L = 2.0 * uH;
            rel -= L * floor((rel + uH) / L);
            v = vec3(dot(rel, uCR[0]), dot(rel, uCR[1]), dot(rel, uCR[2]));
            if(v.z < 3.2 || v.z > 95.0 || abs(v.x) > v.z * uLim.x || abs(v.y) > v.z * uLim.y){
                gl_Position = vec4(2.0, 2.0, 2.0, 1.0);
                gl_PointSize = 0.0;
                vCol = vec3(0.0);
                vKind = 0.0;
                vBlur = 0.0;
                return;
            }
        } else {
            v = aPos;
        }
        float kind = aInfo.z;

        /* cursor pushes stars/dust away from its line of sight; clicks send a ring */
        if(kind < 1.9 || kind > 2.1){
            float wz = exp(-pow((v.z - ZC) / 16.0, 2.0)) * (v.z / 10.0);
            vec2 push = vec2(0.0);
            for(int k = 0; k < 4; k++){
                vec2 dc = uMT[k].xy / FOCAL;
                vec2 o = v.xy - dc * v.z;
                float r = sqrt(dot(o, o) + 1e-4);
                float sd = r / v.z * FOCAL;
                push += o / r * exp(-(sd * sd) / 0.04) * uMT[k].z;
            }
            v.xy += push * (1.3 + 0.7 * uMS) * wz * uMOn;
            v.z += length(push) * 0.25 * wz * uMOn;
            float wzs = exp(-pow((v.z - ZC) / 30.0, 2.0)) * (v.z / 10.0);
            for(int i = 0; i < 3; i++){
                if(uSh[i].w > 0.0){
                    vec2 dc = uSh[i].xy / FOCAL;
                    vec2 o = v.xy - dc * v.z;
                    float r = sqrt(dot(o, o) + 1e-4);
                    float sd = r / v.z * FOCAL;
                    float g = exp(-pow((sd - uSh[i].z * 0.9) / 0.10, 2.0)) * exp(-uSh[i].z * 1.4) * uSh[i].w;
                    v.xy += o / r * g * 2.4 * wzs;
                }
            }
        }

        float z = max(v.z, 0.3);
        vec2 uv = v.xy / z * FOCAL;
        gl_Position = vec4(uv.x * 2.0 * uRes.y / uRes.x, uv.y * 2.0, 0.0, 1.0);
        float lum = aInfo.x;
        float ci = aInfo.y;
        float fadeZ = smoothstep(3.2, 6.5, z) * (1.0 - smoothstep(78.0, 92.0, z));
        float coc = max(0.0, 1.0 / z - 1.0 / 60.0) * 20.0;
        float size = 2.0;
        float inten = 0.0;
        if(kind < 0.5){
            float flux = lum / (z * z) * uGain * fadeZ;
            size = 1.0 + 2.4 * sqrt(flux);
            inten = (1.0 - exp(-flux * 0.9)) * 1.5;
            inten += (0.115 + 0.14 * min(lum, 1.0)) * fadeZ;
        } else if(kind < 1.5){
            size = 46.0;
            inten = 1.0 * (1.0 - smoothstep(55.0, 80.0, z));
        } else if(kind < 2.5){
            size = 16.0 + lum * 8.0;
            inten = lum * 0.9;
        } else {
            size = lum;
            inten = 0.035 * smoothstep(1.0, 1.7, z) * (1.0 - smoothstep(3.0, 3.6, z));
            coc = 0.0;
        }
        size = min(size, 60.0) + coc * 2.0;
        inten /= (1.0 + coc * 0.4);
        float draw = max(size, 2.0);
        inten *= min(1.0, (size * size) / (draw * draw));
        gl_PointSize = min(draw * uPxScale, uMaxPt);
        float tau = tauTo(vec3(v.xy, z));
        vCol = starColor(ci) * inten * exp(-tau * vec3(0.70, 1.10, 1.80));
        vKind = kind;
        vBlur = coc;
    }`;

        const FS_STAR = `#version 300 es
    precision highp float;
    in vec3 vCol;
    in float vKind;
    in float vBlur;
    out vec4 o;
    void main(){
        vec2 pc = gl_PointCoord * 2.0 - 1.0;
        float r2 = dot(pc, pc);
        if(r2 > 1.0) discard;
        float prof;
        if(vKind < 0.5){
            float sharp = 1.0 / (1.0 + vBlur * 0.8);
            prof = exp(-r2 * (10.0 * sharp + 3.0)) + 0.10 * exp(-r2 * 2.4);
        } else if(vKind < 1.5){
            prof = exp(-r2 * 46.0) + 0.34 * exp(-r2 * 10.0) + 0.10 * exp(-r2 * 2.4);
            float sp = exp(-abs(pc.x) * 28.0) * exp(-abs(pc.y) * 1.9)
                     + exp(-abs(pc.y) * 28.0) * exp(-abs(pc.x) * 1.9);
            prof += 0.45 * sp;
        } else if(vKind < 2.5){
            prof = exp(-r2 * 16.0) + 0.30 * exp(-r2 * 4.0);
        } else {
            float r = sqrt(r2);
            prof = smoothstep(1.0, 0.80, r) * (0.60 + 0.40 * r);
        }
        vec3 c = vCol * prof;
        o = vec4(c, max(c.r, max(c.g, c.b)));
    }`;
        const VS_MET = `#version 300 es
    precision highp float;
    precision highp int;
    precision highp sampler3D;
    in vec3 aPos;
    in vec2 aDir;
    in vec3 aMisc;
    uniform vec2 uRes;
    ${COMMON}
    out float vU;
    out float vSide;
    out float vFade;
    out vec3 vTau;
    void main(){
        float side = aMisc.x;
        float u = aMisc.y;
        float fade = aMisc.z;
        float z = aPos.z;
        vec2 uv = aPos.xy / z * FOCAL;
        float w = (0.040 * (1.0 - 0.82 * u) + 0.006) * FOCAL / z;
        uv += aDir * side * w;
        gl_Position = vec4(uv.x * 2.0 * uRes.y / uRes.x, uv.y * 2.0, 0.0, 1.0);
        vU = u;
        vSide = side;
        vFade = fade;
        float tau = tauTo(aPos);
        vTau = exp(-tau * vec3(0.95, 1.50, 2.40));
    }`;
        const FS_MET = `#version 300 es
    precision highp float;
    in float vU;
    in float vSide;
    in float vFade;
    in vec3 vTau;
    out vec4 o;
    void main(){
        float along = pow(1.0 - vU, 1.8);
        float cross = exp(-vSide * vSide * 2.6);
        vec3 head = vec3(1.00, 0.97, 0.92);
        vec3 mid  = vec3(0.38, 0.84, 1.00);
        vec3 tail = vec3(0.40, 0.30, 0.95);
        vec3 c = mix(head, mid, smoothstep(0.0, 0.22, vU));
        c = mix(c, tail, smoothstep(0.25, 0.9, vU));
        c *= along * cross * vFade * 1.7 * vTau;
        o = vec4(c, max(c.r, max(c.g, c.b)));
    }`;

        /* =====================================================================
            GL HELPERS
        ===================================================================== */

        function compile(type, src){

            const s = gl.createShader(type);

            gl.shaderSource(s, src);
            gl.compileShader(s);

            if(!gl.getShaderParameter(s, gl.COMPILE_STATUS)){

                const log = gl.getShaderInfoLog(s);

                gl.deleteShader(s);

                throw new Error(log);

            }

            return s;

        }

        function makeProgram(vsSrc, fsSrc, attribs){

            const p = gl.createProgram();

            gl.attachShader(p, compile(gl.VERTEX_SHADER, vsSrc));
            gl.attachShader(p, compile(gl.FRAGMENT_SHADER, fsSrc));

            if(attribs){
                for(const name in attribs)
                    gl.bindAttribLocation(p, attribs[name], name);
            }

            gl.linkProgram(p);

            if(!gl.getProgramParameter(p, gl.LINK_STATUS))
                throw new Error(gl.getProgramInfoLog(p));

            return p;

        }

        function uniforms(p, names){

            const o = {};

            for(const n of names)
                o[n] = gl.getUniformLocation(p, n);

            return o;

        }

        /* =====================================================================
            STATE (everything per-frame is preallocated)
        ===================================================================== */

        const flags = { nebula:true, stars:true, meteors:true };

        let cssW = 2, cssH = 2, aspect = 1;
        let pxScale = 1;
        let maxPt = 64;
        let XL = 1, YL = 1;

        let simT = 0, frameNo = 0, actS = 0;

        function rnd(a, b){ return a + Math.random() * (b - a); }
        function clamp(x, a, b){ return x < a ? a : (x > b ? b : x); }
        function sstep(a, b, x){ const t = clamp((x - a) / (b - a), 0, 1); return t * t * (3 - 2 * t); }
        function gauss(){ return (Math.random() + Math.random() + Math.random() - 1.5) / 0.7; }

        /* ---- camera ---- */
        const cam = { p:[0, 0, 0], yaw:0, pitch:0, roll:0, wy:0, wp:0 };
        const wp = [0, 0, 0];
        const camR = new Float32Array(9);          /* columns: right, up, forward */
        const camP = new Float32Array(3);
        const fwd = [0, 0, 1], rgt = [1, 0, 0], upv = [0, 1, 0];
        let wpCount = 0;

        function updateCamRot(){

            const cy = Math.cos(cam.yaw), sy = Math.sin(cam.yaw);
            const cp = Math.cos(cam.pitch), sp = Math.sin(cam.pitch);

            fwd[0] = sy * cp; fwd[1] = sp; fwd[2] = cy * cp;

            let rx = fwd[2], rz = -fwd[0];
            const rl = Math.sqrt(rx * rx + rz * rz) || 1;
            rx /= rl; rz /= rl;

            const ux = fwd[1] * rz;
            const uy = fwd[2] * rx - fwd[0] * rz;
            const uz = -fwd[1] * rx;

            const cr = Math.cos(cam.roll), sr = Math.sin(cam.roll);

            rgt[0] = rx * cr + ux * sr;  rgt[1] = 0 * cr + uy * sr;  rgt[2] = rz * cr + uz * sr;
            upv[0] = ux * cr - rx * sr;  upv[1] = uy * cr - 0 * sr;  upv[2] = uz * cr - rz * sr;

            camR[0] = rgt[0]; camR[1] = rgt[1]; camR[2] = rgt[2];
            camR[3] = upv[0]; camR[4] = upv[1]; camR[5] = upv[2];
            camR[6] = fwd[0]; camR[7] = fwd[1]; camR[8] = fwd[2];

            camP[0] = cam.p[0]; camP[1] = cam.p[1]; camP[2] = cam.p[2];

        }

        function newWaypoint(first){

            /* a random point somewhere out in the huge 3D space */
            const az = first ? cam.yaw + rnd(-0.8, 0.8) : rnd(0, Math.PI * 2);
            const el = rnd(-0.55, 0.55);
            const d = rnd(38, 90);

            wp[0] = cam.p[0] + Math.cos(el) * Math.sin(az) * d;
            wp[1] = cam.p[1] + Math.sin(el) * d;
            wp[2] = cam.p[2] + Math.cos(el) * Math.cos(az) * d;

            wpCount++;

        }

        function updateCamera(dt){

            let dx = wp[0] - cam.p[0], dy = wp[1] - cam.p[1], dz = wp[2] - cam.p[2];
            let dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz);

            if(dist < 4.0){
                newWaypoint(false);
                dx = wp[0] - cam.p[0]; dy = wp[1] - cam.p[1]; dz = wp[2] - cam.p[2];
                dist = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz);
            }

            /* turn to face the waypoint */
            const tyaw = Math.atan2(dx, dz);
            const tpitch = Math.asin(clamp(dy / dist, -0.75, 0.75));

            let ey = tyaw - cam.yaw;
            ey = Math.atan2(Math.sin(ey), Math.cos(ey));
            const ep = tpitch - cam.pitch;

            const w0 = 0.45;

            cam.wy += (w0 * w0 * ey - 2 * w0 * cam.wy) * dt;
            cam.wp += (w0 * w0 * ep - 2 * w0 * cam.wp) * dt;

            cam.wy = clamp(cam.wy, -CAM_TURN, CAM_TURN);
            cam.wp = clamp(cam.wp, -CAM_TURN * 0.7, CAM_TURN * 0.7);

            cam.yaw += cam.wy * dt;
            cam.pitch = clamp(cam.pitch + cam.wp * dt, -1.0, 1.0);

            /* bank slightly into turns */
            cam.roll += (clamp(-cam.wy * 1.6, -0.16, 0.16) - cam.roll) * (1 - Math.exp(-dt * 0.8));

            updateCamRot();

            /* fly towards it, but only once roughly facing it */
            const align = (fwd[0] * dx + fwd[1] * dy + fwd[2] * dz) / dist;
            const speed = CAM_SPEED * sstep(0.2, 0.9, align) * (0.3 + 0.7 * sstep(0, 16, dist));

            cam.p[0] += fwd[0] * speed * dt;
            cam.p[1] += fwd[1] * speed * dt;
            cam.p[2] += fwd[2] * speed * dt;

            camP[0] = cam.p[0]; camP[1] = cam.p[1]; camP[2] = cam.p[2];

        }

        /* world <-> view helpers (no allocation: results land in tv) */
        const tv = [0, 0, 0];

        function toView(x, y, z){

            const rx = x - cam.p[0], ry = y - cam.p[1], rz = z - cam.p[2];

            tv[0] = rx * rgt[0] + ry * rgt[1] + rz * rgt[2];
            tv[1] = rx * upv[0] + ry * upv[1] + rz * upv[2];
            tv[2] = rx * fwd[0] + ry * fwd[1] + rz * fwd[2];

        }

        function dirToWorld(x, y, z){

            tv[0] = rgt[0] * x + upv[0] * y + fwd[0] * z;
            tv[1] = rgt[1] * x + upv[1] * y + fwd[1] * z;
            tv[2] = rgt[2] * x + upv[2] * y + fwd[2] * z;

        }

        /* ---- mouse (uv space, y up) ---- */
        let mOn = 0, mSpeed = 0, mHave = false;
        let mx = 0, my = 0, pmx = 0, pmy = 0;
        const MT = new Float32Array(12);          /* 4 trailing cursor samples */
        const MT_W = [0.44, 0.29, 0.18, 0.09];
        let trailT = 0;

        function updateMouse(dt, px, py){

            const inside = px > -500;

            mOn += ((inside ? 1 : 0) - mOn) * (1 - Math.exp(-dt * 7));

            if(inside){

                const tx = (px - cssW / 2) / cssH;
                const ty = -(py - cssH / 2) / cssH;

                if(!mHave){ mx = tx; my = ty; pmx = tx; pmy = ty; mHave = true; for(let k = 0; k < 4; k++){ MT[k*3] = tx; MT[k*3+1] = ty; } }

                pmx = mx; pmy = my;

                const a = 1 - Math.exp(-dt * 16);
                mx += (tx - mx) * a;
                my += (ty - my) * a;

                const sp = Math.sqrt((mx - pmx) * (mx - pmx) + (my - pmy) * (my - pmy)) / dt;
                mSpeed += (sp - mSpeed) * (1 - Math.exp(-dt * 8));

            }
            else{

                mSpeed *= Math.exp(-dt * 4);

            }

            /* trailing samples give the push a soft wake */
            trailT += dt;

            if(trailT > 0.07){

                trailT = 0;

                for(let k = 3; k > 0; k--){
                    MT[k*3] = MT[(k-1)*3];
                    MT[k*3+1] = MT[(k-1)*3+1];
                }

            }

            MT[0] = mx; MT[1] = my;

            for(let k = 0; k < 4; k++) MT[k*3+2] = MT_W[k];

        }

        /* ---- shock rings from clicks ---- */
        const SH = new Float32Array(12);          /* x, y, age, strength */

        function updateShocks(dt){

            for(let i = 0; i < 3; i++){

                if(SH[i*4+3] > 0){

                    SH[i*4+2] += dt;

                    if(SH[i*4+2] > 3.0) SH[i*4+3] = 0;

                }

            }

        }

        /* =====================================================================
            STARS (static world-space buffers) + dynamic list
        ===================================================================== */

        const CI_STAR = new Float32Array(N_GIANT);

        function pickCI(){

            const r = Math.random();

            if(r < 0.42) return rnd(0.02, 0.26);
            if(r < 0.72) return rnd(0.26, 0.50);
            if(r < 0.92) return rnd(0.50, 0.70);

            return rnd(0.70, 1.0);

        }

        function genStarBuffer(n, H){

            const a = new Float32Array(n * 7);

            for(let i = 0; i < n; i++){

                const o = i * 7;

                a[o]   = rnd(0, 2 * H);
                a[o+1] = rnd(0, 2 * H);
                a[o+2] = rnd(0, 2 * H);
                a[o+3] = 0.03 + 1.6 * Math.pow(Math.random(), 5.0);
                a[o+4] = pickCI();
                a[o+5] = 0;
                a[o+6] = 0;

            }

            return a;

        }

        /* giants (lights) and dust motes are small CPU lists in periodic cubes */
        const gPos = new Float32Array(N_GIANT * 3);
        const mPos = new Float32Array(N_MOTE * 3);
        const mSize = new Float32Array(N_MOTE);
        const mCI = new Float32Array(N_MOTE);

        for(let i = 0; i < N_GIANT; i++){

            gPos[i*3]   = rnd(0, 2 * H_GIANT);
            gPos[i*3+1] = rnd(0, 2 * H_GIANT);
            gPos[i*3+2] = rnd(0, 2 * H_GIANT);

            CI_STAR[i] = Math.random() < 0.7 ? rnd(0.58, 1.0) : rnd(0.05, 0.3);

        }

        for(let i = 0; i < N_MOTE; i++){

            mPos[i*3]   = rnd(0, 2 * H_MOTE);
            mPos[i*3+1] = rnd(0, 2 * H_MOTE);
            mPos[i*3+2] = rnd(0, 2 * H_MOTE);
            mSize[i] = rnd(34, 90);
            mCI[i] = rnd(0.45, 0.8);

        }

        const dyn = new Float32Array(DYN_MAX * 7);
        let dynCount = 0;

        const LP = new Float32Array(40);          /* live lights                 */
        const LC = new Float32Array(40);
        const cLP = new Float32Array(40);         /* snapshot for the nebula pass */
        const cLC = new Float32Array(40);
        const gNear = new Int32Array(6);
        const gNearD = new Float32Array(6);

        const SC_A = [1.0, 0.52, 0.30], SC_B = [1.0, 0.84, 0.64], SC_C = [0.96, 0.96, 1.0], SC_D = [0.58, 0.76, 1.0];

        function starRGB(t, out){

            const a = SC_A, b = SC_B, c = SC_C, d = SC_D;

            let s = sstep(0.0, 0.35, t);
            let r0 = a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * s, r1 = a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * s, r2 = a[2] + (b[2] - a[2]) * s;

            s = sstep(0.30, 0.62, t);
            r0 += (c[0] - r0) * s; r1 += (c[1] - r1) * s; r2 += (c[2] - r2) * s;

            s = sstep(0.60, 1.00, t);
            r0 += (d[0] - r0) * s; r1 += (d[1] - r1) * s; r2 += (d[2] - r2) * s;

            out[0] = r0; out[1] = r1; out[2] = r2;

        }

        const rgbTmp = [0, 0, 0];

        function wrapRel(v, c, H){

            const L = 2 * H;

            let r = v - c;

            return r - L * Math.floor((r + H) / L);

        }

        function pushDyn(x, y, z, lum, ci, kind){

            if(dynCount >= DYN_MAX) return;

            const o = dynCount * 7;

            dyn[o] = x; dyn[o+1] = y; dyn[o+2] = z;
            dyn[o+3] = lum; dyn[o+4] = ci; dyn[o+5] = kind; dyn[o+6] = 0;

            dynCount++;

        }

        function modPos(v, L){ return ((v % L) + L) % L; }

        /* per-frame: giants, motes, meteor heads -> dynamic buffer + live lights */
        function buildDynamic(){

            dynCount = 0;

            const L = 2 * H_GIANT;
            const cx = modPos(cam.p[0], L), cy = modPos(cam.p[1], L), cz = modPos(cam.p[2], L);

            for(let k = 0; k < 6; k++){ gNear[k] = -1; gNearD[k] = 1e9; }

            for(let i = 0; i < N_GIANT; i++){

                const rx = wrapRel(gPos[i*3], cx, H_GIANT);
                const ry = wrapRel(gPos[i*3+1], cy, H_GIANT);
                const rz = wrapRel(gPos[i*3+2], cz, H_GIANT);

                const vx = rx * rgt[0] + ry * rgt[1] + rz * rgt[2];
                const vy = rx * upv[0] + ry * upv[1] + rz * upv[2];
                const vz = rx * fwd[0] + ry * fwd[1] + rz * fwd[2];

                const d2 = rx * rx + ry * ry + rz * rz;

                /* keep the 6 nearest as lights (any direction) */
                if(d2 < gNearD[5]){

                    let k = 5;

                    while(k > 0 && gNearD[k-1] > d2){ gNearD[k] = gNearD[k-1]; gNear[k] = gNear[k-1]; k--; }

                    gNearD[k] = d2; gNear[k] = i;

                }

                if(vz > 3.2 && vz < 80 && Math.abs(vx) < vz * XL && Math.abs(vy) < vz * YL)
                    pushDyn(vx, vy, vz, 1.0, CI_STAR[i], 1);

            }

            /* lights: giants (distance-faded), then meteor heads */
            LP.fill(0); LC.fill(0);

            for(let j = 0; j < 10; j++){ LP[j*4+2] = 1e4; LP[j*4+3] = 1; }

            let n = 0;

            for(let k = 0; k < 6; k++){

                const i = gNear[k];

                if(i < 0) continue;

                const rx = wrapRel(gPos[i*3], cx, H_GIANT);
                const ry = wrapRel(gPos[i*3+1], cy, H_GIANT);
                const rz = wrapRel(gPos[i*3+2], cz, H_GIANT);

                const dist = Math.sqrt(gNearD[k]);
                const fade = 1 - sstep(24, 38, dist);

                starRGB(CI_STAR[i], rgbTmp);

                LP[n*4] = cam.p[0] + rx; LP[n*4+1] = cam.p[1] + ry; LP[n*4+2] = cam.p[2] + rz; LP[n*4+3] = 0.06;
                LC[n*4] = rgbTmp[0] * 1.15 * fade; LC[n*4+1] = rgbTmp[1] * 1.15 * fade; LC[n*4+2] = rgbTmp[2] * 1.15 * fade;

                n++;

            }

            /* dust motes: floating specks close to the camera */
            const LM = 2 * H_MOTE;
            const mcx = modPos(cam.p[0], LM), mcy = modPos(cam.p[1], LM), mcz = modPos(cam.p[2], LM);

            for(let i = 0; i < N_MOTE; i++){

                const rx = wrapRel(mPos[i*3], mcx, H_MOTE);
                const ry = wrapRel(mPos[i*3+1], mcy, H_MOTE);
                const rz = wrapRel(mPos[i*3+2], mcz, H_MOTE);

                const vx = rx * rgt[0] + ry * rgt[1] + rz * rgt[2];
                const vy = rx * upv[0] + ry * upv[1] + rz * upv[2];
                const vz = rx * fwd[0] + ry * fwd[1] + rz * fwd[2];

                if(vz > 1.0 && vz < 3.6 && Math.abs(vx) < vz * XL && Math.abs(vy) < vz * YL)
                    pushDyn(vx, vy, vz, mSize[i], mCI[i], 3);

            }

            /* meteor heads: glow + light the gas */
            let lights = 0;

            for(let m = 0; m < N_MET; m++){

                if(!mAlive[m]) continue;

                const life = metLife(m);

                toView(mP[m*3], mP[m*3+1], mP[m*3+2]);

                if(tv[2] > 1.0)
                    pushDyn(tv[0], tv[1], tv[2], 1.4 * life, 0.58, 2);

                if(lights < 3 && n < 9){

                    LP[n*4] = mP[m*3]; LP[n*4+1] = mP[m*3+1]; LP[n*4+2] = mP[m*3+2]; LP[n*4+3] = 0.45;
                    LC[n*4] = 0.75 * life; LC[n*4+1] = 0.95 * life; LC[n*4+2] = 1.25 * life;

                    n++; lights++;

                }

            }

        }

        /* =====================================================================
            METEORS (world space, fixed arrays)
        ===================================================================== */

        const mAlive = new Uint8Array(N_MET);
        const mP = new Float32Array(N_MET * 3);
        const mV = new Float32Array(N_MET * 3);
        const mAge = new Float32Array(N_MET);
        const mDying = new Float32Array(N_MET);
        const mAcc = new Float32Array(N_MET);
        const mHist = new Float32Array(N_MET * TRAIL * 3);
        const mHN = new Int32Array(N_MET);
        let meteorTimer = 2.5;

        function metLife(m){

            return Math.min(1, mAge[m] / 0.35) * (mDying[m] > 0 ? Math.max(0, 1 - mDying[m] / 0.9) : 1);

        }

        function spawnMeteor(){

            let m = -1;

            for(let i = 0; i < N_MET; i++) if(!mAlive[i]){ m = i; break; }

            if(m < 0) return;

            const sx = Math.random() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1;
            const z = rnd(6, 15);
            const speed = rnd(4.6, 7.2) * Math.pow(z / 10, 0.6);

            const vx = -sx * (XL * z + 1.5);
            const vy = rnd(0.10, 0.80) * YL * z;

            dirToWorld(vx, vy, z);
            mP[m*3]   = cam.p[0] + tv[0];
            mP[m*3+1] = cam.p[1] + tv[1];
            mP[m*3+2] = cam.p[2] + tv[2];

            dirToWorld(sx * speed, -rnd(0.25, 0.55) * speed * 0.55, rnd(-0.6, 0.6));
            mV[m*3] = tv[0]; mV[m*3+1] = tv[1]; mV[m*3+2] = tv[2];

            mAge[m] = 0; mDying[m] = 0; mAcc[m] = 0;
            mHN[m] = 1;
            mHist[m*TRAIL*3] = mP[m*3]; mHist[m*TRAIL*3+1] = mP[m*3+1]; mHist[m*TRAIL*3+2] = mP[m*3+2];
            mAlive[m] = 1;

        }

        function updateMeteors(dt){

            meteorTimer -= dt;

            if(meteorTimer <= 0){

                spawnMeteor();
                meteorTimer = rnd(3.2, 7.5);

            }

            for(let m = 0; m < N_MET; m++){

                if(!mAlive[m]) continue;

                mAge[m] += dt;

                if(mDying[m] === 0){

                    toView(mP[m*3], mP[m*3+1], mP[m*3+2]);

                    const z = tv[2];

                    /* repelled by the cursor like a magnet */
                    if(mOn > 0.02 && z > 1.0){

                        const ox = tv[0] - (mx / FOCAL) * z;
                        const oy = tv[1] - (my / FOCAL) * z;
                        const r = Math.sqrt(ox * ox + oy * oy + 1e-4);
                        const sd = r / z * FOCAL;
                        const t = sd / 0.17;
                        const g = 1.0 / Math.pow(1.0 + t * t, 1.5);
                        const wz = Math.exp(-((z - ZC) * (z - ZC)) / 400.0);
                        const k = 12.0 * g * wz * (z / 10) * mOn;

                        dirToWorld(ox / r * k, oy / r * k, 0);

                        mV[m*3] += tv[0] * dt; mV[m*3+1] += tv[1] * dt; mV[m*3+2] += tv[2] * dt;

                    }

                    mP[m*3] += mV[m*3] * dt; mP[m*3+1] += mV[m*3+1] * dt; mP[m*3+2] += mV[m*3+2] * dt;

                    mAcc[m] += dt;

                    if(mAcc[m] >= 0.03){

                        mAcc[m] = 0;

                        /* shift history by one slot (fixed array, no allocation) */
                        const base = m * TRAIL * 3;
                        const n = Math.min(mHN[m], TRAIL - 1);

                        for(let k = n; k > 0; k--){
                            mHist[base + k*3]   = mHist[base + (k-1)*3];
                            mHist[base + k*3+1] = mHist[base + (k-1)*3+1];
                            mHist[base + k*3+2] = mHist[base + (k-1)*3+2];
                        }

                        mHN[m] = n + 1;

                    }

                    mHist[m*TRAIL*3] = mP[m*3]; mHist[m*TRAIL*3+1] = mP[m*3+1]; mHist[m*TRAIL*3+2] = mP[m*3+2];

                    toView(mP[m*3], mP[m*3+1], mP[m*3+2]);

                    const zz = tv[2];

                    if(mAge[m] > 0.6 && (zz < 1.0 || zz > 140 || Math.abs(tv[0]) > XL * zz + 2.5 || Math.abs(tv[1]) > YL * zz + 2.5 || mAge[m] > 9))
                        mDying[m] = 0.0001;

                }
                else{

                    mDying[m] += dt;

                    if(mDying[m] > 1.0) mAlive[m] = 0;

                }

            }

        }

        /* click: ring through the stars, impulse on meteors */
        let shockNext = 0;

        function shock(px, py){

            const ux = (px - cssW / 2) / cssH;
            const uy = -(py - cssH / 2) / cssH;

            const i = shockNext; shockNext = (shockNext + 1) % 3;

            SH[i*4] = ux; SH[i*4+1] = uy; SH[i*4+2] = 0; SH[i*4+3] = 1;

            for(let m = 0; m < N_MET; m++){

                if(!mAlive[m]) continue;

                toView(mP[m*3], mP[m*3+1], mP[m*3+2]);

                const z = Math.max(tv[2], 1);
                const ox = tv[0] - (ux / FOCAL) * z;
                const oy = tv[1] - (uy / FOCAL) * z;
                const r = Math.sqrt(ox * ox + oy * oy + 1e-4);
                const sd = r / z * FOCAL;
                const g = Math.exp(-(sd * sd) / 0.12);

                dirToWorld(ox / r * 3.0 * g, oy / r * 3.0 * g, 0);

                mV[m*3] += tv[0]; mV[m*3+1] += tv[1]; mV[m*3+2] += tv[2];

            }

        }

        /* ribbons: world history -> view space vertices */
        const metData = new Float32Array(N_MET * TRAIL * 2 * 8);
        const metBounds = new Int32Array(N_MET * 2);
        let metVerts = 0, metCount = 0;

        function buildMeteors(){

            let v = 0;
            metCount = 0;

            for(let m = 0; m < N_MET; m++){

                if(!mAlive[m]) continue;

                const n = mHN[m];

                if(n < 2) continue;

                const life = metLife(m);
                const first = v;

                let px = 0, py = 0, have = false;

                const base = m * TRAIL * 3;

                for(let k = 0; k < n; k++){

                    const ka = Math.max(0, k - 1), kb = Math.min(n - 1, k + 1);

                    toView(mHist[base + k*3], mHist[base + k*3+1], mHist[base + k*3+2]);
                    const x = tv[0], y = tv[1], z = Math.max(tv[2], 0.6);

                    toView(mHist[base + ka*3], mHist[base + ka*3+1], mHist[base + ka*3+2]);
                    const ax = tv[0], ay = tv[1], az = Math.max(tv[2], 0.6);

                    toView(mHist[base + kb*3], mHist[base + kb*3+1], mHist[base + kb*3+2]);
                    const bx = tv[0], by = tv[1], bz = Math.max(tv[2], 0.6);

                    const u = k / (n - 1);

                    let tx = (ax / az - bx / bz) * FOCAL;
                    let ty = (ay / az - by / bz) * FOCAL;

                    const tl = Math.sqrt(tx * tx + ty * ty);

                    if(tl > 1e-6){ tx /= tl; ty /= tl; px = tx; py = ty; have = true; }
                    else if(have){ tx = px; ty = py; }
                    else { tx = 1; ty = 0; }

                    const dx = -ty, dy = tx;

                    for(let sd = -1; sd <= 1; sd += 2){

                        const o = v * 8;

                        metData[o] = x; metData[o+1] = y; metData[o+2] = z;
                        metData[o+3] = dx; metData[o+4] = dy;
                        metData[o+5] = sd; metData[o+6] = u; metData[o+7] = life;

                        v++;

                    }

                }

                metBounds[metCount*2] = first;
                metBounds[metCount*2+1] = v - first;
                metCount++;

            }

            metVerts = v;

        }

        /* =====================================================================
            GL RESOURCES
        ===================================================================== */

        let P_BAKE, P_NEB, P_COMP, P_STAR, P_MET, P_SHARP;
        let U_NEB, U_COMP, U_STAR, U_MET, U_SHARP;
        let tNoise;
        let vaoEmpty, vaoGrid, vaoDyn, vaoMet;
        let bufGrid, bufDyn, bufMet;
        let gridCount = 0;
        let rtFloat = false;

        const neb = {
            tex:[null, null],
            fbo:[null, null],
            sharp:null,
            sharpFbo:null,
            disp:0,
            w:2, h:2,
            band:0,
            histValid:false,
            ready:false,
            cycP:new Float32Array(3),
            cycR:new Float32Array(9),
            dispP:new Float32Array(3),
            dispR:new Float32Array(9),
            cycT:0,
            dispT:0,
            cycFrame:0,
            bandsNow:8
        };

        function bakeNoise(){

            const hasF = rtFloat;

            tNoise = gl.createTexture();
            gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_3D, tNoise);

            function alloc(float){

                gl.texImage3D(
                    gl.TEXTURE_3D, 0,
                    float ? gl.RGBA16F : gl.RGBA8,
                    NS, NS, NS, 0,
                    gl.RGBA,
                    float ? gl.HALF_FLOAT : gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE,
                    null
                );

            }

            alloc(hasF);

            gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_3D, gl.TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER, gl.LINEAR);
            gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_3D, gl.TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER, gl.LINEAR);
            gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_3D, gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_S, gl.REPEAT);
            gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_3D, gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_T, gl.REPEAT);
            gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_3D, gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_R, gl.REPEAT);

            const fbo = gl.createFramebuffer();

            gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, fbo);
            gl.framebufferTextureLayer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, gl.COLOR_ATTACHMENT0, tNoise, 0, 0);

            if(gl.checkFramebufferStatus(gl.FRAMEBUFFER) !== gl.FRAMEBUFFER_COMPLETE){

                if(!hasF)
                    throw new Error("noise bake framebuffer incomplete");

                gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_3D, tNoise);
                alloc(false);
                gl.framebufferTextureLayer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, gl.COLOR_ATTACHMENT0, tNoise, 0, 0);

                if(gl.checkFramebufferStatus(gl.FRAMEBUFFER) !== gl.FRAMEBUFFER_COMPLETE)
                    throw new Error("noise bake framebuffer incomplete");

            }

            gl.useProgram(P_BAKE);
            gl.bindVertexArray(vaoEmpty);
            gl.viewport(0, 0, NS, NS);
            gl.disable(gl.BLEND);

            const uL = gl.getUniformLocation(P_BAKE, "uLayer");
            const uS = gl.getUniformLocation(P_BAKE, "uSize");

            gl.uniform1f(uS, NS);

            for(let z = 0; z < NS; z++){

                gl.framebufferTextureLayer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, gl.COLOR_ATTACHMENT0, tNoise, 0, z);
                gl.uniform1f(uL, (z + 0.5) / NS);
                gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLES, 0, 3);

            }

            gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, null);
            gl.deleteFramebuffer(fbo);

        }

        function makeNebulaTargets(){

            for(let k = 0; k < 2; k++){

                if(neb.tex[k]) gl.deleteTexture(neb.tex[k]);
                if(neb.fbo[k]) gl.deleteFramebuffer(neb.fbo[k]);

                neb.tex[k] = gl.createTexture();
                gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, neb.tex[k]);

                gl.texImage2D(
                    gl.TEXTURE_2D, 0,
                    rtFloat ? gl.RGBA16F : gl.RGBA8,
                    neb.w, neb.h, 0,
                    gl.RGBA,
                    rtFloat ? gl.HALF_FLOAT : gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE,
                    null
                );

                gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER, gl.LINEAR);
                gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER, gl.LINEAR);
                gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_S, gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
                gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_T, gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE);

                neb.fbo[k] = gl.createFramebuffer();
                gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, neb.fbo[k]);
                gl.framebufferTexture2D(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, gl.COLOR_ATTACHMENT0, gl.TEXTURE_2D, neb.tex[k], 0);

                if(rtFloat && gl.checkFramebufferStatus(gl.FRAMEBUFFER) !== gl.FRAMEBUFFER_COMPLETE){

                    rtFloat = false;
                    makeNebulaTargets();
                    return;

                }

            }

            /* sharpened copy that the composite displays */
            if(neb.sharp) gl.deleteTexture(neb.sharp);
            if(neb.sharpFbo) gl.deleteFramebuffer(neb.sharpFbo);

            neb.sharp = gl.createTexture();
            gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, neb.sharp);

            gl.texImage2D(
                gl.TEXTURE_2D, 0,
                rtFloat ? gl.RGBA16F : gl.RGBA8,
                neb.w, neb.h, 0,
                gl.RGBA,
                rtFloat ? gl.HALF_FLOAT : gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE,
                null
            );

            gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER, gl.LINEAR);
            gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER, gl.LINEAR);
            gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_S, gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE);
            gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D, gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_T, gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE);

            neb.sharpFbo = gl.createFramebuffer();
            gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, neb.sharpFbo);
            gl.framebufferTexture2D(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, gl.COLOR_ATTACHMENT0, gl.TEXTURE_2D, neb.sharp, 0);

            gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, null);

            neb.disp = 0;
            neb.band = 0;
            neb.histValid = false;

        }

        function initGL(){

            vaoEmpty = gl.createVertexArray();

            P_BAKE = makeProgram(VS_FULL, FS_BAKE);
            P_NEB  = makeProgram(VS_FULL, FS_NEB);
            P_COMP = makeProgram(VS_COMP, FS_COMP, { aG:0 });
            P_STAR = makeProgram(VS_STAR, FS_STAR, { aPos:0, aInfo:1 });
            P_MET  = makeProgram(VS_MET, FS_MET, { aPos:0, aDir:1, aMisc:2 });
            P_SHARP = makeProgram(VS_FULL, FS_SHARP);
            U_SHARP = uniforms(P_SHARP, ["uTex","uDim"]);

            U_NEB = uniforms(P_NEB, ["uRes","uFrame","uAct","uSteps","uHist","uBlend","uLP","uLC","uNoise","uTime","uCP","uCR","uBias","uK","uBand","uM","uHP","uHR","uHistOn"]);
            U_COMP = uniforms(P_COMP, ["uTex","uRes","uNDim","uM","uCP","uCR","uNP","uNR","uFrame"]);
            U_STAR = uniforms(P_STAR, ["uRes","uPxScale","uGain","uMaxPt","uWorld","uH","uCw","uLim","uMT","uMOn","uMS","uSh","uNoise","uTime","uCP","uCR","uBias"]);
            U_MET = uniforms(P_MET, ["uRes","uNoise","uTime","uCP","uCR","uBias"]);

            rtFloat = !!gl.getExtension("EXT_color_buffer_float") || !!gl.getExtension("EXT_color_buffer_half_float");

            const pr = gl.getParameter(gl.ALIASED_POINT_SIZE_RANGE);

            maxPt = Math.max(16, Math.min(512, pr ? pr[1] : 64));

            bakeNoise();

            /* composite grid: coarse mesh, the warp is computed per vertex */
            const GXN = 48, GYN = 27;
            const g = new Float32Array(GXN * GYN * 6 * 2);
            let o = 0;

            for(let j = 0; j < GYN; j++){
                for(let i = 0; i < GXN; i++){

                    const x0 = i / GXN, x1 = (i + 1) / GXN, y0 = j / GYN, y1 = (j + 1) / GYN;

                    g[o++] = x0; g[o++] = y0;  g[o++] = x1; g[o++] = y0;  g[o++] = x0; g[o++] = y1;
                    g[o++] = x1; g[o++] = y0;  g[o++] = x1; g[o++] = y1;  g[o++] = x0; g[o++] = y1;

                }
            }

            gridCount = GXN * GYN * 6;

            bufGrid = gl.createBuffer();
            vaoGrid = gl.createVertexArray();
            gl.bindVertexArray(vaoGrid);
            gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, bufGrid);
            gl.bufferData(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, g, gl.STATIC_DRAW);
            gl.enableVertexAttribArray(0);
            gl.vertexAttribPointer(0, 2, gl.FLOAT, false, 8, 0);

            /* static star buffers (world space) */
            function starVAO(data){

                const buf = gl.createBuffer();
                const vao = gl.createVertexArray();

                gl.bindVertexArray(vao);
                gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, buf);
                gl.bufferData(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, data, gl.STATIC_DRAW);
                gl.enableVertexAttribArray(0);
                gl.vertexAttribPointer(0, 3, gl.FLOAT, false, 28, 0);
                gl.enableVertexAttribArray(1);
                gl.vertexAttribPointer(1, 4, gl.FLOAT, false, 28, 12);

                return { buf, vao };

            }

            for(const L of STAR_LAYERS){

                const s = starVAO(genStarBuffer(L.n, L.H));

                L.buf = s.buf;
                L.vao = s.vao;

            }

            /* dynamic buffer (giants, motes, meteor heads) */
            bufDyn = gl.createBuffer();
            vaoDyn = gl.createVertexArray();
            gl.bindVertexArray(vaoDyn);
            gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, bufDyn);
            gl.bufferData(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, dyn.byteLength, gl.DYNAMIC_DRAW);
            gl.enableVertexAttribArray(0);
            gl.vertexAttribPointer(0, 3, gl.FLOAT, false, 28, 0);
            gl.enableVertexAttribArray(1);
            gl.vertexAttribPointer(1, 4, gl.FLOAT, false, 28, 12);

            /* meteor ribbons */
            bufMet = gl.createBuffer();
            vaoMet = gl.createVertexArray();
            gl.bindVertexArray(vaoMet);
            gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, bufMet);
            gl.bufferData(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, metData.byteLength, gl.DYNAMIC_DRAW);
            gl.enableVertexAttribArray(0);
            gl.vertexAttribPointer(0, 3, gl.FLOAT, false, 32, 0);
            gl.enableVertexAttribArray(1);
            gl.vertexAttribPointer(1, 2, gl.FLOAT, false, 32, 12);
            gl.enableVertexAttribArray(2);
            gl.vertexAttribPointer(2, 3, gl.FLOAT, false, 32, 20);

            gl.bindVertexArray(null);

        }

        try{

            initGL();

        }catch(err){

            console.warn("[GChat Enhanced] 3D space renderer unavailable:", err && err.message ? err.message : err);

            return null;

        }

        /* =====================================================================
            SIZING
        ===================================================================== */

        let devRatio = 1;

        function applySizes(){

            const asp = cssW / cssH;

            aspect = asp;
            XL = asp * 0.5 / FOCAL * 1.08;
            YL = 0.5 / FOCAL * 1.08;

            /* output buffer: at least 4K, as a WHOLE-NUMBER multiple of the screen's
               pixels, so the browser's downscale is an exact box average (a fractional
               ratio makes small stars shimmer as they move) */
            const devW = Math.max(16, Math.round(cssW * devRatio));
            const devH = Math.max(16, Math.round(cssH * devRatio));
            const S = clamp(Math.ceil(Math.sqrt(Q.pixels / (devW * devH))), 1, Q.ssMax || 6);

            let w = devW * S;
            let h = devH * S;

            const mv = gl.getParameter(gl.MAX_VIEWPORT_DIMS);
            const lim = Math.min(8192, mv ? mv[0] : 8192, mv ? mv[1] : 8192);

            if(w > lim || h > lim){

                const k = Math.min(lim / w, lim / h);

                w = Math.floor(w * k);
                h = Math.floor(h * k);

            }

            if(cv.width !== w || cv.height !== h){ cv.width = w; cv.height = h; }

            pxScale = cv.height / cssH;

            /* nebula texture: about half of the window height (+ overscan) */
            const nebH = Q.nebH > 0 ? Q.nebH : clamp(Math.round(cssH * 0.5), 360, 720);

            neb.h = Math.round(nebH * OVERSCAN);
            neb.w = Math.round(neb.h * asp);

            makeNebulaTargets();

        }

        function resize(w, h, dpr){

            if(w < 16 || h < 16) return;

            cssW = w; cssH = h;

            devRatio = clamp(dpr || 1, 1, 4);

            applySizes();

        }

        /* =====================================================================
            RENDERING
        ===================================================================== */

        const quadTmp = null;

        function beginCycle(){

            neb.cycP.set(camP);
            neb.cycR.set(camR);
            neb.cycT = simT;
            neb.cycFrame++;
            neb.bandsNow = Q.bands;

            cLP.set(LP);
            cLC.set(LC);

        }

        function nebulaBand(){

            if(neb.band === 0)
                beginCycle();

            const dst = 1 - neb.disp;
            const K = neb.bandsNow;

            gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, neb.fbo[dst]);
            gl.viewport(0, 0, neb.w, neb.h);
            gl.disable(gl.BLEND);

            gl.useProgram(P_NEB);
            gl.bindVertexArray(vaoEmpty);

            gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE0);
            gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_3D, tNoise);
            gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE1);
            gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, neb.tex[neb.disp]);

            gl.uniform1i(U_NEB.uNoise, 0);
            gl.uniform1i(U_NEB.uHist, 1);
            gl.uniform2f(U_NEB.uRes, neb.w, neb.h);
            gl.uniform1f(U_NEB.uTime, neb.cycT);
            gl.uniform1f(U_NEB.uFrame, neb.cycFrame);
            gl.uniform1f(U_NEB.uAct, actS);
            gl.uniform1i(U_NEB.uSteps, Q.steps);
            gl.uniform1f(U_NEB.uBias, 0);
            gl.uniform1f(U_NEB.uBlend, rtFloat ? 0.82 : 0.6);
            gl.uniform1i(U_NEB.uK, K);
            gl.uniform1i(U_NEB.uBand, neb.band);
            gl.uniform1f(U_NEB.uM, OVERSCAN);
            gl.uniform3fv(U_NEB.uCP, neb.cycP);
            gl.uniformMatrix3fv(U_NEB.uCR, false, neb.cycR);
            gl.uniform3fv(U_NEB.uHP, neb.dispP);
            gl.uniformMatrix3fv(U_NEB.uHR, false, neb.dispR);
            gl.uniform1f(U_NEB.uHistOn, neb.histValid ? 1 : 0);
            gl.uniform4fv(U_NEB.uLP, cLP);
            gl.uniform4fv(U_NEB.uLC, cLC);

            gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLES, 0, 3);

            neb.band++;

            if(neb.band >= K){

                neb.band = 0;
                neb.disp = dst;
                neb.dispP.set(neb.cycP);
                neb.dispR.set(neb.cycR);
                neb.dispT = neb.cycT;
                neb.histValid = true;
                neb.ready = true;

                sharpenDisplayed();

            }

        }

        function sharpenDisplayed(){

            gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, neb.sharpFbo);
            gl.viewport(0, 0, neb.w, neb.h);
            gl.disable(gl.BLEND);

            gl.useProgram(P_SHARP);
            gl.bindVertexArray(vaoEmpty);

            gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE1);
            gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, neb.tex[neb.disp]);

            gl.uniform1i(U_SHARP.uTex, 1);
            gl.uniform2f(U_SHARP.uDim, neb.w, neb.h);

            gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLES, 0, 3);

        }

        function bindCommon(U){

            gl.uniform1i(U.uNoise, 0);
            gl.uniform1f(U.uTime, neb.dispT);
            gl.uniform1f(U.uBias, 0);
            gl.uniform3fv(U.uCP, camP);
            gl.uniformMatrix3fv(U.uCR, false, camR);

        }

        function drawStarSet(vao, count, world, H){

            gl.bindVertexArray(vao);

            gl.uniform1f(U_STAR.uWorld, world);
            gl.uniform1f(U_STAR.uH, H);

            if(world > 0.5){

                const L = 2 * H;

                gl.uniform3f(U_STAR.uCw, modPos(cam.p[0], L), modPos(cam.p[1], L), modPos(cam.p[2], L));

            }

            gl.drawArrays(gl.POINTS, 0, count);

        }

        function render(){

            frameNo++;

            const W = cv.width, H = cv.height;

            gl.bindFramebuffer(gl.FRAMEBUFFER, null);
            gl.viewport(0, 0, W, H);
            gl.disable(gl.BLEND);

            /* composite: nebula warped to the live camera */
            gl.useProgram(P_COMP);
            gl.bindVertexArray(vaoGrid);

            gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE2);
            gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D, neb.sharp);

            gl.uniform1i(U_COMP.uTex, 2);
            gl.uniform2f(U_COMP.uRes, W, H);
            gl.uniform2f(U_COMP.uNDim, neb.w, neb.h);
            gl.uniform1f(U_COMP.uM, OVERSCAN);
            gl.uniform1f(U_COMP.uFrame, frameNo);
            gl.uniform3fv(U_COMP.uCP, camP);
            gl.uniformMatrix3fv(U_COMP.uCR, false, camR);
            gl.uniform3fv(U_COMP.uNP, neb.dispP);
            gl.uniformMatrix3fv(U_COMP.uNR, false, neb.dispR);

            gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLES, 0, gridCount);

            gl.enable(gl.BLEND);
            gl.blendFunc(gl.ONE, gl.ONE);

            gl.activeTexture(gl.TEXTURE0);
            gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_3D, tNoise);

            if(flags.stars){

                gl.useProgram(P_STAR);

                bindCommon(U_STAR);

                gl.uniform2f(U_STAR.uRes, W, H);
                gl.uniform1f(U_STAR.uPxScale, pxScale);
                gl.uniform1f(U_STAR.uGain, 520.0);
                gl.uniform1f(U_STAR.uMaxPt, maxPt);
                gl.uniform2f(U_STAR.uLim, XL, YL);
                gl.uniform3fv(U_STAR.uMT, MT);
                gl.uniform1f(U_STAR.uMOn, mOn);
                gl.uniform1f(U_STAR.uMS, Math.min(1, mSpeed * 0.6));
                gl.uniform4fv(U_STAR.uSh, SH);

                for(const L of STAR_LAYERS)
                    drawStarSet(L.vao, L.n, 1, L.H);

                if(dynCount > 0){

                    gl.bindVertexArray(vaoDyn);
                    gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, bufDyn);
                    gl.bufferSubData(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, 0, dyn, 0, dynCount * 7);

                    gl.uniform1f(U_STAR.uWorld, 0);

                    gl.drawArrays(gl.POINTS, 0, dynCount);

                }

            }

            if(flags.meteors && metCount > 0){

                gl.useProgram(P_MET);
                gl.bindVertexArray(vaoMet);

                bindCommon(U_MET);

                gl.uniform2f(U_MET.uRes, W, H);

                gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, bufMet);
                gl.bufferSubData(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, 0, metData, 0, metVerts * 8);

                for(let i = 0; i < metCount; i++)
                    gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLE_STRIP, metBounds[i*2], metBounds[i*2+1]);

            }

            gl.disable(gl.BLEND);
            gl.bindVertexArray(null);

        }

        /* =====================================================================
            FRAME + ADAPTIVE QUALITY (driven only by frame times)
        ===================================================================== */

        /* The nebula changes slowly, so it is refreshed at a constant ~12 Hz of
           real time no matter how fast the display is (it is spread over several
           frames, so per-frame GPU work shrinks as the frame rate rises).
           Visual quality is LOCKED: only how the work is spread over frames may
           change, unless the machine falls below ~40 fps. */
        const CYCLE_HZ = 12;
        const TARGET_FPS = 120;
        const LOCK_BELOW_MS = 25;

        const dtBuf = new Float32Array(90);
        let dtN = 0;
        let dtEMA = 8.3, adaptFrames = 0;

        function bandsFor(hz){

            return clamp(Math.round(hz / CYCLE_HZ), 4, 16);

        }

        if(Q.refreshHz)
            Q.bands = bandsFor(Math.min(Q.refreshHz, 240));

        function adapt(dtMs){

            if(dtMs > 250 || dtMs < 1) return;

            dtEMA = dtEMA * 0.97 + dtMs * 0.03;

            /* measure the display's refresh rate once (median frame time) */
            if(!Q.refreshHz){

                dtBuf[dtN++] = dtMs;

                if(dtN >= dtBuf.length){

                    dtBuf.sort();

                    Q.refreshHz = clamp(1000 / dtBuf[dtBuf.length >> 1], 48, 260);
                    Q.bands = bandsFor(Q.refreshHz);

                }

                return;

            }

            adaptFrames++;

            if(adaptFrames < 240 || adaptFrames % 120 !== 0)
                return;

            const wantDt = 1000 / Math.min(Q.refreshHz, TARGET_FPS) * 1.15;

            if(dtEMA <= wantDt)
