                return;

            let changed = false;

            /* 1) spread the nebula work over more frames (invisible) */
            if(Q.bands < 16){

                Q.bands = Math.min(16, Q.bands + 4);
                changed = true;

            }
            /* 2) only if we are really struggling (< ~40 fps) touch quality */
            else if(dtEMA > LOCK_BELOW_MS){

                if(Q.stage === 0){ Q.steps = Math.max(40, Q.steps - 8); }
                else if(Q.stage === 1){ Q.nebH = Math.max(300, Math.round((neb.h / OVERSCAN) * 0.85)); applySizes(); }
                else if(Q.stage === 2){ Q.ssMax = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(Math.sqrt(Q.pixels / (cssW * devRatio * cssH * devRatio))) - 1); applySizes(); }
                else return;

                Q.stage++;
                changed = true;

            }

            if(!changed) return;

            adaptFrames = 0;
            dtEMA = wantDt;

            if(typeof console !== "undefined")
                console.info("[GChat Enhanced] 3D space: bands=" + Q.bands + " stage=" + Q.stage + " (frame " + dtMs.toFixed(1) + " ms)");

        }

        function update(dtMs, act, mouseX, mouseY){

            const dt = clamp(dtMs / 1000, 0.0005, 0.05);

            simT += dt;

            actS += (act - actS) * (1 - Math.exp(-dt * 3));

            updateMouse(dt, mouseX, mouseY);
            updateCamera(dt);
            updateMeteors(dt);
            updateShocks(dt);
            buildDynamic();
            buildMeteors();

        }

        function frame(dtMs, act, now, mouseX, mouseY){

            update(dtMs, act, mouseX, mouseY);

            if(flags.nebula)
                nebulaBand();

            render();

            adapt(dtMs);

        }

        function destroy(){

            try{

                const lose = gl.getExtension("WEBGL_lose_context");

                if(lose) lose.loseContext();

            }catch(e){}

        }

        /* start somewhere sensible: first waypoint ahead of the camera */
        cam.p[0] = rnd(-500, 500); cam.p[1] = rnd(-200, 200); cam.p[2] = rnd(-500, 500);
        cam.yaw = rnd(-Math.PI, Math.PI);
        newWaypoint(true);
        updateCamRot();
        neb.dispR.set(camR);
        neb.dispP.set(camP);

        return {
            flags,
            resize,
            frame,
            update,
            render,
            nebulaBand,
            shock,
            destroy,
            get ready(){ return neb.ready; },
            get gl(){ return gl; },
            get quality(){ return Q; },
            get stats(){ return { canvas:cv.width + 'x' + cv.height, nebula:neb.w + 'x' + neb.h, fps:+(1000 / dtEMA).toFixed(1), frameMs:+dtEMA.toFixed(2), refreshHz:Q.refreshHz ? +Q.refreshHz.toFixed(0) : null, bands:Q.bands, nebulaHz:+((1000 / dtEMA) / Q.bands).toFixed(1), steps:Q.steps, qualityStage:Q.stage, waypoints:wpCount, maxPt:maxPt }; },
            _dbg:{
                cam, wp, camR,
                get T(){ return simT; },
                set T(v){ simT = v; },
                get dyn(){ return dynCount; },
                get nebReady(){ return neb.ready; }
            }
        };

    }


    function makeGLCanvas(){

        const c =
            document.createElement("canvas");

        c.id =
            "gchat-canvas-gl";

        /* fades in once its first frames are drawn, so a fresh or
           half-initialised canvas is never visible */
        c.style.opacity = "0";
        c.style.transition = "opacity .7s ease";

        chatArea.insertBefore(
            c,
            canvas
        );

        return c;

    }

    const spaceQuality =
        (window.__gceSpaceQuality = window.__gceSpaceQuality || {});

    let glCanvas = makeGLCanvas();

    const spaceGL = {
        ok:false,
        api:null,
        w:0,
        h:0,
        last:0,
        frames:0,
        shown:false,
        retiring:null
    };

    function createSpaceApi(c){

        try{

            return createSpaceRenderer(c, { quality: spaceQuality });

        }catch(err){

            console.warn("[GChat Enhanced] 3D space failed:", err);

            return null;

        }

    }

    function disableSpaceGL(){

        spaceGL.ok = false;

        canvas.style.visibility = "";

        glCanvas.style.display = "none";

    }

    function startSpaceGL(){

        const api = createSpaceApi(glCanvas);

        if(!api){

            disableSpaceGL();

            return;

        }

        spaceGL.api = api;
        spaceGL.ok = true;
        spaceGL.w = 0;
        spaceGL.h = 0;
        spaceGL.last = 0;
        spaceGL.frames = 0;
        spaceGL.shown = false;

        glCanvas.style.display = "";

        canvas.style.visibility = "hidden";

    }

    function bindGLCanvas(c){

        c.addEventListener(
            "webglcontextlost",
            e => {

                e.preventDefault();

                if(c === glCanvas)
                    disableSpaceGL();

            },
            {signal}
        );

        c.addEventListener(
            "webglcontextrestored",
            () => {

                if(c === glCanvas)
                    startSpaceGL();

            },
            {signal}
        );

    }

    function retireSpaceCanvas(r){

        if(!r)
            return;

        if(spaceGL.retiring === r)
            spaceGL.retiring = null;

        try{

            if(r.api)
                r.api.destroy();

        }catch(err){}

        if(r.canvas && r.canvas.parentNode)
            r.canvas.remove();

    }

    /* Rebuilds the whole 3D canvas from scratch. The old one stays on
       screen until the new one has drawn a few frames, then they swap. */
    function reloadSpaceCanvas(){

        if(signal.aborted)
            return;

        resizeCanvas();

        const next = makeGLCanvas();

        const api = createSpaceApi(next);

        if(!api){

            next.remove();

            return;

        }

        bindGLCanvas(next);

        retireSpaceCanvas(spaceGL.retiring);

        spaceGL.retiring = {
            canvas:glCanvas,
            api:spaceGL.api
        };

        glCanvas = next;

        spaceGL.api = api;
        spaceGL.ok = true;
        spaceGL.w = 0;
        spaceGL.h = 0;
        spaceGL.last = 0;
        spaceGL.frames = 0;
        spaceGL.shown = false;

    }

    bindGLCanvas(glCanvas);

    startSpaceGL();

    /* Opening a chat: reload the canvas twice, once the layout has settled */
    let reloadTimers = [];

    function scheduleSpaceReloads(){

        reloadTimers.forEach(clearTimeout);

        reloadTimers =
            [900, 2300].map(
                ms => setTimeout(reloadSpaceCanvas, ms)
            );

    }

    scheduleSpaceReloads();

    /* switching to another chat changes the URL: do the same again */
    let lastHref = location.href;

    const hrefTimer = setInterval(() => {

        if(location.href !== lastHref){

            lastHref = location.href;

            scheduleSpaceReloads();

        }

    }, 700);

    /* keep the canvas matched to the chat area whenever its layout changes
       (it is often not final yet at the moment a chat opens) */
    let resizeTimer = 0;

    const sizeObserver =
        new ResizeObserver(() => {

            clearTimeout(resizeTimer);

            resizeTimer = setTimeout(() => {

                if(signal.aborted)
                    return;

                resizeCanvas();

                spaceGL.w = 0;
                spaceGL.h = 0;

            }, 140);

        });

    sizeObserver.observe(chatArea);

    signal.addEventListener(
        "abort",
        () => {

            clearInterval(hrefTimer);
            clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
            reloadTimers.forEach(clearTimeout);
            sizeObserver.disconnect();

        }
    );

    /* clicks send a shock through stars and meteors */
    document.addEventListener(
        "pointerdown",
        e => {

            if(!spaceGL.ok)
                return;

            const rect =
                canvas.getBoundingClientRect();

            spaceGL.api.shock(
                e.clientX - rect.left,
                e.clientY - rect.top
            );

        },
        {signal}
    );

    function drawSpaceGL(){

        /* layout not ready yet: wait instead of drawing into a bad size */
        if(canvas.width < 32 || canvas.height < 32){

            resizeCanvas();

            return;

        }

        const api = spaceGL.api;

        const now = performance.now();

        const dt =
            spaceGL.last
            ? now - spaceGL.last
            : 16;

        spaceGL.last = now;

        if(
            canvas.width !== spaceGL.w ||
            canvas.height !== spaceGL.h
        ){

            api.resize(
                canvas.width,
                canvas.height,
                window.devicePixelRatio || 1
            );

            spaceGL.w = canvas.width;
            spaceGL.h = canvas.height;

        }

        try{

            api.frame(
                dt,
                activity,
                now,
                mouse.x,
                mouse.y
            );

        }catch(err){

            console.warn("[GChat Enhanced] 3D space error:", err);

            disableSpaceGL();

            return;

        }

        spaceGL.frames++;

        if(!spaceGL.shown && spaceGL.frames >= 5 && api.ready){

            spaceGL.shown = true;

            glCanvas.style.opacity = "1";

            const r = spaceGL.retiring;

            if(r)
                setTimeout(() => retireSpaceCanvas(r), 900);

        }

    }


    let wave = 0;

    let camX = 0;
    let camY = 0;


    /* Smooth, coherent 3D-ish flow (no grid, no random jitter) */
    function nebulaFlowAngle(x,y,z,t){

        const a =
            Math.sin(
                x * .0021 + t +
                Math.sin(y * .0017 + t * .7) * 1.8
            );

        const b =
            Math.cos(
                y * .0023 - t * .8 +
                Math.sin(x * .0014 + z * 3 + t * .5) * 1.6
            );

        return (a + b) * Math.PI * .9 + z * 2;

    }


    function drawNebula(){

        if(spaceGL.ok){

            drawSpaceGL();

            return;

        }


        wave +=
            .002 +
            activity * .001;


        /* keep the shared flow field alive (the stars still use it) */
        for(const node of flowField){

            node.angle =
                Math.sin(
                    wave +
                    node.offset +
                    node.x * .28 +
                    node.y * .31
                ) *
                Math.PI;

        }


        /* very slow camera sway + gentle mouse parallax */
        const mx =
            mouse.x < -500
            ? 0
            : (mouse.x / canvas.width - .5);

        const my =
            mouse.y < -500
            ? 0
            : (mouse.y / canvas.height - .5);

        const camTargetX =
            Math.sin(wave * .35) * 14 +
            mx * 44;

        const camTargetY =
            Math.cos(wave * .28) * 9 +
            my * 30;

        camX += (camTargetX - camX) * .02;
        camY += (camTargetY - camY) * .02;


        ensureNebula2D();

        ctx.save();

        let mode = "";

        for(const p of nebulaParticles){

            const depthSpeed =
                .35 + p.z * .9;

            const angle =
                nebulaFlowAngle(
                    p.x,
                    p.y,
                    p.z,
                    wave
                );

            p.vx +=
                Math.cos(angle) * .007 * depthSpeed;

            p.vy +=
                Math.sin(angle) * .007 * depthSpeed;

            p.vx *= .985;
            p.vy *= .985;

            p.x += p.vx;
            p.y += p.vy;


            /* perspective: near = larger */
            const scale =
                .85 + p.z * .3;

            const r =
                p.radius * scale;

            const margin =
                r + 70;


            if(p.x < -margin)
                p.x = canvas.width + margin;

            if(p.x > canvas.width + margin)
                p.x = -margin;

            if(p.y < -margin)
                p.y = canvas.height + margin;

            if(p.y > canvas.height + margin)
                p.y = -margin;


            /* parallax: near layers shift more than far ones */
            const par =
                .15 + p.z * 1.2;

            const px = p.x - camX * par;
            const py = p.y - camY * par;


            const speed =
                Math.min(
                    1,
                    Math.hypot(p.vx,p.vy) * 1.6
                );

            const breathe =
                .92 +
                Math.sin(wave * 3 + p.phase) * .08;

            const alpha =
                (
                    p.alpha +
                    (p.dust ? 0 : activity * .02)
                ) * breathe;


            const wantMode =
                p.dust
                ? "destination-out"
                : "lighter";

            if(mode !== wantMode){

                ctx.globalCompositeOperation = wantMode;
                mode = wantMode;

            }

            ctx.globalAlpha =
                p.dust
                ? Math.min(.45, alpha)
                : alpha * (p.sprite === "cored" ? 1.5 : 1.8);


            /* stretch along motion so blobs read as flowing gas */
            const dir =
                Math.atan2(p.vy,p.vx);

            const stretch =
                1 + speed * .5 + (p.dust ? .7 : 0);

            const cos = Math.cos(dir);
            const sin = Math.sin(dir);

            ctx.setTransform(
                cos * stretch, sin * stretch,
                -sin,          cos,
                px,            py
            );

            ctx.drawImage(
                nebulaSprites[p.color][p.sprite],
                -r,
                -r,
                r * 2,
                r * 2
            );

        }

        ctx.restore();

    }


    /* ==========================================
                    STARS
    ========================================== */

    function drawStars(){

        stars.sort(
            (a,b)=>
                a.depth-b.depth
        );


        for(const s of stars){

            const field =
                sampleFlow(
                    s.x,
                    s.y
                );


            s.vx +=
                Math.cos(
                    field.angle
                ) *
                (.012 + s.depth*.018);


            s.vy +=
                Math.sin(
                    field.angle
                ) *
                (.012 + s.depth*.018);


            /* Mouse repulsion */

            const dx =
                s.x - mouse.x;

            const dy =
                s.y - mouse.y;

            const dist =
                Math.hypot(dx,dy);


            if(
                dist > 0 &&
                dist < 180
            ){

                const force =
                    (180-dist)/180;


                const strength =
                    force *
                    (.20 + s.depth*.45);


                s.vx +=
                    dx/dist *
                    strength *
                    .035;


                s.vy +=
                    dy/dist *
                    strength *
                    .035;

            }


            s.vx *= .985;
            s.vy *= .985;


            s.x += s.vx;
            s.y += s.vy;


            if(s.x < -20)
                s.x =
                    canvas.width + 20;

            if(s.x >
                canvas.width + 20)
                s.x = -20;


            if(s.y < -20)
                s.y =
                    canvas.height + 20;

            if(s.y >
                canvas.height + 20)
                s.y = -20;


            s.twinkle +=
                s.twinkleSpeed;


            const glow =
                (
                    Math.sin(
                        s.twinkle
                    ) + 1
                ) / 2;


            const brightness =
                .18 +
                glow*.45 +
                s.depth*.35 +
                activity*.12;


            ctx.shadowBlur =
                3 +
                glow*7 +
                s.depth*8 +
                activity*10;


            ctx.shadowColor =
                `rgba(${s.color},.8)`;


            ctx.fillStyle =
                `rgba(${s.color},${brightness})`;


            ctx.beginPath();

            ctx.arc(
                s.x,
                s.y,
                s.radius,
                0,
                Math.PI * 2
            );

            ctx.fill();

        }


        ctx.shadowBlur = 0;


        /* Constellations */

        ctx.save();

        ctx.globalCompositeOperation =
            "lighter";


        const connectionDistance =
            115;


        for(
            let i=0;
            i<stars.length;
            i++
        ){

            const a =
                stars[i];


            if(a.depth < .25)
                continue;


            for(
                let j=i+1;
                j<stars.length;
                j++
            ){

                const b =
                    stars[j];


                if(b.depth < .25)
                    continue;


                const dx =
                    a.x-b.x;

                const dy =
                    a.y-b.y;


                const dist =
                    Math.hypot(
                        dx,
                        dy
                    );


                if(
                    dist >
                    connectionDistance
                )
                    continue;


                const strength =
                    (
                        1 -
                        dist /
                        connectionDistance
                    ) *
                    Math.min(
                        a.depth,
                        b.depth
                    ) *
                    .12;


                ctx.strokeStyle =
                    `rgba(
                        130,
                        170,
                        255,
                        ${strength}
                    )`;


                ctx.lineWidth = .5;


                ctx.beginPath();

                ctx.moveTo(
                    a.x,
                    a.y
                );

                ctx.lineTo(
                    b.x,
                    b.y
                );

                ctx.stroke();

            }

        }


        ctx.restore();

    }


    /* ==========================================
                AMBIENT PARTICLES
    ========================================== */

    function drawAmbientParticles(){

        ctx.save();

        ctx.globalCompositeOperation =
            "lighter";


        for(
            const p of ambientParticles
        ){

            p.x += p.vx;
            p.y += p.vy;


            const dx =
                p.x-mouse.x;

            const dy =
                p.y-mouse.y;

            const dist =
                Math.hypot(dx,dy);


            if(
                dist > 0 &&
                dist < 120
            ){

                const force =
                    (120-dist)/120;


                p.x +=
                    dx/dist *
                    force *
                    .15;


                p.y +=
                    dy/dist *
                    force *
                    .15;

            }


            if(p.x < -10)
                p.x =
                    canvas.width + 10;

            if(p.x >
                canvas.width + 10)
                p.x = -10;


            if(p.y < -10)
                p.y =
                    canvas.height + 10;

            if(p.y >
                canvas.height + 10)
                p.y = -10;


            ctx.fillStyle =
                `rgba(
                    160,
                    190,
                    255,
                    ${p.alpha}
                )`;


            ctx.shadowBlur = 5;

            ctx.shadowColor =
                "rgba(130,170,255,.4)";


            ctx.beginPath();

            ctx.arc(
                p.x,
                p.y,
                p.radius,
                0,
                Math.PI * 2
            );

            ctx.fill();

        }


        ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

        ctx.restore();

    }


    /* ==========================================
                SHOOTING STARS
    ========================================== */

    const shootingStars = [];

    let shootingStarTimer = null;


    function spawnShootingStar(){

        const angle =
            (
                25 +
                Math.random()*10
            ) *
            Math.PI / 180;


        /* Slower = smoother */

        const speed =
            7 +
            Math.random()*4;


        const startSide =
            Math.random() < .5;


        (spaceGL.ok ? [] : shootingStars).push({

            x:
                startSide
                ? -120
                : canvas.width + 120,

            y:
                Math.random() *
                canvas.height *
                .45,

            vx:
                Math.cos(angle) *
                speed *
                (startSide ? 1 : -1),

            vy:
                Math.sin(angle) *
                speed,

            life:1,

            maxLife:
                100 +
                Math.random()*40,

            width:
                1.5 +
                Math.random()*1,

            tail:
                80 +
                Math.random()*80,

            hue:
                Math.random() < .4
                ? "120,210,255"
                : "255,255,255"

        });


        shootingStarTimer =
            setTimeout(
                spawnShootingStar,
                3000 +
                Math.random()*3500
            );

    }


    spawnShootingStar();


    function drawShootingStars(){

        ctx.save();

        ctx.globalCompositeOperation =
            "lighter";


        for(
            let i =
                shootingStars.length-1;
            i>=0;
            i--
        ){

            const s =
                shootingStars[i];


            s.x += s.vx;
            s.y += s.vy;


            s.life -=
                1 / s.maxLife;


            if(
                s.life <= 0 ||
                s.x < -300 ||
                s.x > canvas.width+300 ||
                s.y > canvas.height+300
            ){

                shootingStars.splice(
                    i,
                    1
                );

                continue;

            }


            const tx =
                s.x -
                s.vx *
                s.tail /
                18;


            const ty =
                s.y -
                s.vy *
                s.tail /
                18;


            const gradient =
                ctx.createLinearGradient(
                    tx,
                    ty,
                    s.x,
                    s.y
                );


            gradient.addColorStop(
                0,
                "rgba(255,255,255,0)"
            );


            gradient.addColorStop(
                .45,
                `rgba(
                    ${s.hue},
                    ${.18*s.life}
                )`
            );


            gradient.addColorStop(
                .8,
                `rgba(
                    ${s.hue},
                    ${.55*s.life}
                )`
            );


            gradient.addColorStop(
                1,
                `rgba(
                    255,
                    255,
                    255,
                    ${.95*s.life}
                )`
            );


            ctx.strokeStyle =
                gradient;


            ctx.lineWidth =
                s.width;


            ctx.shadowBlur = 12;


            ctx.shadowColor =
                `rgba(
                    ${s.hue},
                    .7
                )`;


            ctx.beginPath();

            ctx.moveTo(
                tx,
                ty
            );

            ctx.lineTo(
                s.x,
                s.y
            );

            ctx.stroke();

        }


        ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

        ctx.restore();

    }


    /* ==========================================
                    CLICK SHOCKWAVE
    ========================================== */

    const shockwaves = [];


    document.addEventListener(
        "pointerdown",
        e=>{

            const rect =
                canvas.getBoundingClientRect();


            shockwaves.push({

                x:
                    e.clientX -
                    rect.left,

                y:
                    e.clientY -
                    rect.top,

                radius:5,

                life:1,

                speed:
                    3 +
                    Math.random()*1.5,

                maxRadius:
                    70 +
                    Math.random()*50

            });

        },
        {signal}
    );


    function drawShockwaves(){

        for(
            let i =
                shockwaves.length-1;
            i>=0;
            i--
        ){

            const w =
                shockwaves[i];


            w.radius +=
                w.speed;


            w.life *=
                .94;


            if(
                w.radius >
                    w.maxRadius ||
                w.life < .03
            ){

                shockwaves.splice(
                    i,
                    1
                );

                continue;

            }


            /*
             * Instead of drawing a giant
             * obvious circle, the shockwave
             * gently pushes nearby stars.
             */

            for(const s of stars){

                const dx =
                    s.x-w.x;

                const dy =
                    s.y-w.y;


                const dist =
                    Math.hypot(
                        dx,
                        dy
                    );


                const difference =
                    Math.abs(
                        dist -
                        w.radius
                    );


                if(
                    dist > 0 &&
                    difference < 35
                ){

                    const force =
                        (
                            1 -
                            difference /
                            35
                        ) *
                        w.life *
                        .035;


                    s.vx +=
                        dx/dist *
                        force *
                        s.depth;


                    s.vy +=
                        dy/dist *
                        force *
                        s.depth;

                }

            }

        }

    }


    /* ==========================================
                    CLICK JUICE
    ========================================== */

    function handleClickJuice(e){

        const flash =
            document.createElement("div");


        flash.className =
            "gchat-flash";


        flash.style.left =
            e.clientX + "px";


        flash.style.top =
            e.clientY + "px";


        document.body.appendChild(
            flash
        );


        setTimeout(
            ()=>flash.remove(),
            200
        );


        for(let i=0;i<5;i++){

            const p =
                document.createElement(
                    "div"
                );


            p.className =
                "gchat-particle";


            p.style.left =
                e.clientX + "px";


            p.style.top =
                e.clientY + "px";


            const angle =
                Math.random() *
                Math.PI * 2;


            const dist =
                8 +
                Math.random()*12;


            p.style.setProperty(
                "--dx",
                Math.cos(angle) *
                dist +
                "px"
            );


            p.style.setProperty(
                "--dy",
                Math.sin(angle) *
                dist +
                "px"
            );


            document.body.appendChild(
                p
            );


            setTimeout(
                ()=>p.remove(),
                450
            );

        }

    }


    document.addEventListener(
        "pointerdown",
        handleClickJuice,
        {signal}
    );


    /* ==========================================
                    ANIMATION
    ========================================== */

    let animationFrame = null;


    function animateBackground(){

        if(
            !canvas.isConnected ||
            !chatArea.isConnected
        )
            return;


        if(!spaceGL.ok){

            ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

        }


        activity +=
            (
                activityTarget -
                activity
            ) *
            .06;


        drawNebula();

        if(!spaceGL.ok){

            drawStars();

            drawAmbientParticles();

            drawShootingStars();

        }

        if(spaceGL.ok){

            if(shockwaves.length) shockwaves.length = 0;

        }
        else{

            drawShockwaves();

        }


        animationFrame =
            requestAnimationFrame(
                animateBackground
            );

    }


    /* ==========================================
                    RESIZE
    ========================================== */

    function handleResize(){

        resizeCanvas();


        for(const s of stars){

            s.x =
                Math.random() *
                canvas.width;

            s.y =
                Math.random() *
                canvas.height;

            s.vx = 0;
            s.vy = 0;

        }


        for(
            const p of nebulaParticles
        ){

            p.x =
                Math.random() *
                canvas.width;

            p.y =
                Math.random() *
                canvas.height;

            p.vx = 0;
            p.vy = 0;

        }

    }


    window.addEventListener(
        "resize",
        handleResize,
        {signal}
    );


    /* ==========================================
                CHAT RELOAD OBSERVER
    ========================================== */

    let observedMain =
        chatArea;


    const chatObserver =
        new MutationObserver(()=>{

            const newMain =
                document.querySelector(
                    '[role="main"]'
                );


            if(
                newMain &&
                newMain !== observedMain
            ){

                observedMain =
                    newMain;


                clearTimeout(
                    reloadTimer
                );


                reloadTimer =
                    setTimeout(()=>{

                        if(currentCleanup){

                            currentCleanup();

                            currentCleanup =
                                null;

                        }


                        startGChatEnhanced();

                    },100);

            }

        });


    chatObserver.observe(
        document.body,
        {
            childList:true,
            subtree:true
        }
    );


    /* ==========================================
                    START
    ========================================== */

    animationFrame =
        requestAnimationFrame(
            animateBackground
        );


    initializing = false;


    if(firstRun){

        alert(
            "Google Chat Enhanced Loaded"
        );

        firstRun = false;

    }


    /* ==========================================
                    CLEANUP
    ========================================== */

    return function cleanup(){

        initializing = false;


        if(animationFrame){

            cancelAnimationFrame(
                animationFrame
            );

            animationFrame = null;

        }


        if(shootingStarTimer){

            clearTimeout(
                shootingStarTimer
            );

            shootingStarTimer = null;

        }


        if(typingTimeout){

            clearTimeout(
                typingTimeout
            );

            typingTimeout = null;

        }


        chatObserver.disconnect();


        eventController.abort();


        if(canvas.parentNode){

            canvas.remove();

        }

        retireSpaceCanvas(spaceGL.retiring);

        if(spaceGL.api){

            spaceGL.api.destroy();

        }

        if(glCanvas.parentNode){

            glCanvas.remove();

        }


        if(style.parentNode){

            style.remove();

        }

    };

}


/* ==========================================
                START CONTROLLER
========================================== */

function startGChatEnhanced(){

    if(currentCleanup){

        currentCleanup();

        currentCleanup = null;

    }


    const cleanup =
        initGChatEnhanced();


    if(cleanup){

        currentCleanup =
            cleanup;

    }

}


/* ==========================================
            WAIT FOR GOOGLE CHAT
========================================== */

if(
    document.querySelector(
        '[role="main"]'
    )
){

    startGChatEnhanced();

}
else{

    const startupObserver =
        new MutationObserver(()=>{

            if(
                document.querySelector(
                    '[role="main"]'
                )
            ){

                startupObserver.disconnect();

                startGChatEnhanced();

            }

        });


    startupObserver.observe(
        document.body,
        {
            childList:true,
            subtree:true
        }
    );

}



/* ==========================================
             EMBEDDED BACKGROUND MUSIC
   The MP3 is embedded so no file picker is needed.
========================================== */

const gchatMusicData = "data:audio/mpeg;base64,";

function setupGChatBackgroundMusic() {
    if (document.getElementById("gchat-music-toggle")) return;

    const audio = new Audio(gchatMusicData);
    audio.loop = true;
    audio.volume = 0.35;
    audio.muted = true;
    audio.preload = "auto";

    const button = document.createElement("button");
    button.id = "gchat-music-toggle";
    button.type = "button";
    button.textContent = "▶";
    button.title = "Play background music";
    button.setAttribute("aria-label", "Play background music");

    Object.assign(button.style, {
        position: "fixed",
        right: "18px",
        bottom: "18px",
        zIndex: "2147483647",
        width: "44px",
        height: "44px",
        display: "flex",
        alignItems: "center",
        justifyContent: "center",
        padding: "0",
        border: "1px solid rgba(150,160,255,.6)",
        borderRadius: "50%",
        background: "rgba(25,30,65,.94)",
        color: "#fff",
        font: "bold 20px/1 Arial, sans-serif",
        boxShadow: "0 4px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.28)",
        backdropFilter: "blur(10px)",
        cursor: "pointer"
    });

    function updateMusicButton() {
        const playing = !audio.paused && !audio.ended;
        button.textContent = playing ? "⏸" : "▶";
        button.title = playing ? "Pause background music" : "Play background music";
        button.setAttribute(
            "aria-label",
            playing ? "Pause background music" : "Play background music"
        );
    }

    audio.addEventListener("play", updateMusicButton);
    audio.addEventListener("pause", updateMusicButton);
    audio.addEventListener("ended", updateMusicButton);

    button.addEventListener("click", async () => {
        if (audio.paused || audio.ended) {
            // Only start audible music after the user clicks the button.
            audio.muted = false;
            try {
                await audio.play();
            } catch (error) {
                updateMusicButton();
            }
        } else {
            audio.pause();
        }
        updateMusicButton();
    });

    document.body.appendChild(button);

    // Music stays stopped and muted until the user clicks ▶.
}

if (document.body) {
    setupGChatBackgroundMusic();
} else {
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", setupGChatBackgroundMusic, { once: true });
}

})();
